actinfo.title: actinfo.txt
actinfo.overview:
This file controls global Act functionalities including item levels, monster behaviors, and waypoints. This file uses the wanderingmon.txt file for a modular list of potential wandering units to spawn.
Any column field name starting with "*" is considered a comment field and is not used by the game.

fields.name: act
fields.description: Defines the ID for the Act

fields.name: town
fields.description: The Act's town area

fields.name: start
fields.description: Where the player starts in the Act

fields.name: maxnpcitemlevel
fields.description: Controls the maximum item level for items sold by the NPC in the Act

fields.name: classlevelrangestart
fields.description: Uses a level's MonLvl (levels) values as a global Act minimum monster level. For example, this is used to determine chest levels in an Act.

fields.name: classlevelrangeend
fields.description: Uses a level's MonLvl (levels) values as a global Act maximum monster level. For example, this is used to determine chest levels in an Act

fields.name: wanderingnpcstart
fields.description: Uses an index to determine which wandering monster class to use when populating areas (See wanderingmon.txt for a list of possible monsters to spawn)

fields.name: wanderingnpcrange
fields.description: This is a modifier that gets added to the wanderingnpcstart value to randomly select an index

fields.name: commonactcof
fields.description: Specifies which ".D2" file to use as for the common Act COF file. This is used to establish the seed when initializing the Act.

fields.name: waypoint#
fields.description: The designated waypoint selection in the Waypoint UI

fields.name: wanderingMonsterPopulateChance
fields.description: The percent chance (from 0 to 100) to spawn a wandering monster (See wanderingmon.txt for a list of possible monsters to spawn)

fields.name: wanderingMonsterRegionTotal
fields.description: The maximum number of wandering monsters allowed at once

fields.name: wanderingPopulateRandomChance
fields.description: A secondary percent chance (from 0 to #) to determine whether to attempt populating with monsters. Only fails if random chance selects 0.

armor.title: armor.txt
armor.overview:
This file controls the functionalities for armor type items. This file is loaded together with other similar files in the following order: weapons.txt, armor.txt, misc.txt. These combined files form the items structure. Technically these files share the same fields, but some fields are exclusive for specific item types, so they are not displayed in the data files that do not need them. These are the fields exclusive to this file.
Any column field name starting with "*" is considered a comment field and is not used by the game.

fields.name: minac
fields.description: The minimum amount of Defense that an armor item type can have.

fields.name: maxac
fields.description: The maximum amount of Defense that an armor item type can have.

fields.name: block
fields.description: Controls the block percent chance that the item provides (out of 100, but caps at 75).

fields.name: armor component
fields.description: Controls the character's graphics and animations for the body components when wearing the armor. Corresponds to a EARMORTYPE (enums).

fields.name: version
fields.description: Defines which game version to create this item (0 = Classic mode | 100 = Expansion mode).

fields.name: compactsave
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then only the item's base stats will be stored in the character save, but not any modifiers or additional stats. If equals 0, then all of the items stats will be saved.

fields.name: rarity
fields.description: Determines the chance that the item will randomly spawn (1/#). The higher the value then the rarer the item will be. This field depends on the spawnable field being enabled, the quest field being disabled, and the item level being less than or equal to the area level. This value is also affected by the relative Act number that the item is dropping in, where the higher the Act number, then the more common the item will drop.

fields.name: spawnable
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then this item can be randomly spawned. If equals 0, then this item will never randomly spawn.

fields.name: DropConditionCalc
fields.description: If the evaluated result of this condition is 0, then prevent the item from being randomly dropped in treasure classes.
fields.format: Treasure Class scope BBE. See BBE/Calc Fields

fields.name: speed
fields.description: If the item type is an armor, then this will affect the Walk/Run Speed reduction when wearing the armor. If the item type is a weapon, then this will affect the Attack Speed reduction when wearing the weapon.

fields.name: reqstr
fields.description: Defines the amount of the Strength attribute needed to use the item.

fields.name: reqdex
fields.description: Defines the amount of the Dexterity attribute needed to use the item.

fields.name: durability
fields.description: Defines the base durability amount that the item will spawn with.

fields.name: nodurability
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the item will not have durability. If equals 0, then the item will have durability.

fields.name: level
fields.description: Controls the base item level. This is used for determining when the item is allowed to drop, such as making sure that the item level is not greater than the monster's level or the area level.

fields.name: ShowLevel
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then display the item level next to the item name. If equals 0, then ignore this.

fields.name: levelreq
fields.description: Controls the player level requirement for being able to use the item.

fields.name: cost
fields.description: Defines the base gold cost of the item when being sold by an NPC. This can be affected by item modifiers and the rarity of the item.

fields.name: gamble cost
fields.description: Defines the gambling gold cost of the item on the Gambling UI.

fields.name: code
fields.description: Defines a unique 3 letter/number code for the item. This is used as an identifier to reference the item.

fields.name: namestr
fields.description: String Key that is used for the base item name.

fields.name: magic lvl
fields.description: Defines the magic level of the item, which can affect how magical item modifiers that can appear on the item (See automagic.txt).

fields.name: auto prefix
fields.description: Automatically picks an item affix name from a designated group (automagic) value, instead of using random prefixes. This is only used when the item is Magical quality.

fields.name: alternategfx
fields.description: Uses a unique 3 letter/number code similar to the defined code fields to determine what in-game graphics to display on the player character when the item is equipped.

fields.name: normcode
fields.description: Links to a code field to determine the normal version of the item

fields.name: ubercode
fields.description: Links to a code field to determine the Exceptional version of the item

fields.name: ultracode
fields.description: Links to a code field to determine the Elite version of the item

fields.name: component
fields.description: Determines the layer of player animation when the item is equipped. This uses a code referenced from the Composit.txt file.

fields.name: invwidth
fields.description: Defines the width of grid cells that the item occupies in the player inventory.

fields.name: invheight
fields.description: Defines the height of grid cells that the item occupies in the player inventory.

fields.name: hasinv
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the item will have its own inventory allowing for the capability to socket gems, runes, or jewels. If equals 0, then the item cannot have sockets.

fields.name: gemsockets
fields.description: Controls the maximum number of sockets allowed on this item. This is limited by the item's size based on the invwidth and invheight fields. This also compares with MaxSockets# (itemtypes).

fields.name: gemapplytype
fields.description: Determines which affect from a gem or rune will be applied when it is socketed into this item (See gems.txt).

fields.name: flippyfile
fields.description: Controls which DC6 file to use for displaying the item in the game world when it is dropped on the ground (uses the file name as the input).

fields.name: invfile
fields.description: Controls which DC6 file to use for displaying the item graphics in the inventory (uses the file name as the input).

fields.name: uniqueinvfile
fields.description: Controls which DC6 file to use for displaying the item graphics in the inventory when it is a Unique quality item (uses the file name as the input).

fields.name: setinvfile
fields.description: Controls which DC6 file to use for displaying the item graphics in the inventory when it is a Set quality item (uses the file name as the input).

fields.name: useable
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the item can be used with the right-click mouse button command (this only works with specific belt items or quest items). If equals 0, then ignore this.

fields.name: stackable
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the item will use a quantity field and handle stacking functionality. This can depend on if the item type is throwable, is a type of ammunition, or is some other kind of miscellaneous item. If equals 0, then the item cannot be stacked.

fields.name: minstack
fields.description: Controls the minimum stack count or quantity that is allowed on the item. This field depends on the stackable field being enabled.

fields.name: maxstack
fields.description: Controls the maximum stack count or quantity that is allowed on the item. This field depends on the stackable field being enabled.

fields.name: spawnstack
fields.description: Controls the stack count or quantity that the item can spawn with. This field depends on the stackable field being enabled.

fields.name: Transmogrify
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the item will use the transmogrify function. If equals 0, then ignore this. This field depends on the useable field being enabled.

fields.name: TMogType
fields.description: Links to a code field to determine which item is chosen to transmogrify this item to.

fields.name: TMogMin
fields.description: Controls the minimum quantity that the transmogrify item will have. This depends on what item was chosen in the TMogType field, and that the transmogrify item has quantity.

fields.name: TMogMax
fields.description: Controls the maximum quantity that the transmogrify item will have. This depends on what item was chosen in the TMogType field, and that the transmogrify item has quantity.

fields.name: type
fields.description: This is the item's type, which controls how the item functions.

fields.name: type2
fields.description: Secondary item type. This is optional but can add more functionalities and possibilities with the item.

fields.name: dropsound
fields.description: Sound used when the item is dropped on the ground.

fields.name: dropsfxframe
fields.description: Defines which frame in the flippyfile animation to play the dropsound sound when the item is dropped on the ground.

fields.name: usesound
fields.description: Sound used when the item is moved in the inventory or used.

fields.name: unique
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the item can only spawn as a Unique quality type. If equals 0, then the item can spawn as other quality types.

fields.name: transparent
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the item will be drawn transparent on the player model (similar to ethereal models). If equals 0, then the item will appear solid on the player model.

fields.name: transtbl
fields.description: Controls what type of transparency to use, based on the transparent field being enabled. Corresponds to a ETRANSTYPE (enums).

fields.name: lightradius
fields.description: Controls the value of the light radius that this item can apply on the monster. This only affects monsters with this item equipped, not other types of units. This is ignored if the item's component on the monster is "lit", "med", or "hvy".

fields.name: belt
fields.description: Controls which belt type to use for belt items only. This field determines what index entry in the belts.txt file to use.

fields.name: quest
fields.description: Controls what quest class is tied to the item which can enable certain item functionalities for a specific quest. Any value greater than 0 will also mean the item is flagged as a quest item, which can affect how it is displayed in tooltips, how it is traded with other players, its item rarity, and how it cannot be sold to an NPC. If equals 0, then the item will not be flagged as a quest item.
table: Respec from Akara Complete, Act 5 Prologue

fields.name: questdiffcheck
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1 and the quest field is enabled, then the game will check the current difficulty setting and will tie that difficulty setting to the quest item. This means that the player can have more than 1 of the same quest item as long each they are obtained per difficulty mode (Normal / Nightmare / Hell). If equals 0 and the quest field is enabled, then the player can only have 1 count of the quest item in the inventory, regardless of difficulty.

fields.name: missiletype
fields.description: Points to an entry's index in missiles.txt, which determines what type of missile is used when using the throwing weapons

fields.name: durwarning
fields.description: Controls the threshold value for durability to display the low durability warning UI. This is only used if the item has durability.

fields.name: qntwarning
fields.description: Controls the threshold value for quantity to display the low quantity warning UI. This is only used if the item has stacks.

fields.name: mindam
fields.description: The minimum physical damage provided by the item.

fields.name: maxdam
fields.description: The maximum physical damage provided by the item.

fields.name: StrBonus
fields.description: The percentage multiplier that gets multiplied the player's current Strength attribute value to modify the bonus damage percent from the equipped item. If this equals 1, then default the value to 100.

fields.name: DexBonus
fields.description: The percentage multiplier that gets multiplied the player's current Dexterity attribute value to modify the bonus damage percent from the equipped item. If this equals 1, then default the value to 100.

fields.name: gemoffset
fields.description: Determines the starting index offset for reading the gems.txt file when determining what effects gems or runes will have the item based on the gemapplytype field. For example, if this value equals 9, then the game will start with index 9 ("Chipped Emerald") and ignore the previously defined gems in the gems.txt file, which can mean that those ignored gems will not apply modifiers when socketed into the item.

fields.name: bitfield1
fields.description: Controls different flags that can affect the item. Uses an integer value to check against different bit fields by using the "&" operator. For example, if the value equals 5 (binary = 101) then that returns true for both the 4 (binary = 100) and 1 (binary = 1) bit field values.
bits: Allow the item to be capable of having Magic quality

The item is classified as a spellcaster item (currently does nothing)
The item is classified as a skill based item (currently does nothing)

fields.name: NPCMin
fields.description: Minimum amount of this item type in Normal rarity that the NPC can sell at once.

fields.name: NPCMax
fields.description: Maximum amount of this item type in Normal rarity that the NPC can sell at once. This must be equal to or greater than the minimum amount.

fields.name: NPCMagicMin
fields.description: Minimum amount of this item type in Magical rarity that the NPC can sell at once

fields.name: NPCMagicMax
fields.description: Maximum amount of this item type in Magical rarity that the NPC can sell at once. This must be equal to or greater than the minimum amount.

fields.name: NPCMagicLvl
fields.description: Maximum magic level allowed for this item type in Magical rarity.

fields.name: Transform
fields.description: Controls the color palette change of the item for the character model graphics. Corresponds to a EITRANSFORMCLASS (enums).

fields.name: InvTrans
fields.description: Controls the color palette change of the item for the inventory graphics. Corresponds to a EITRANSFORMCLASS (enums).

fields.name: SkipName
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1 and the item is Unique rarity, then skip adding the item's base name in its title. If equals 0, then ignore this.

fields.name: NightmareUpgrade
fields.description: Links to another item's code field. Used to determine which item will replace this item when being generated in the NPC's store while the game is playing in Nightmare difficulty. If this field's code equals "xxx", then this item will not change in this difficulty.

fields.name: HellUpgrade
fields.description: Links to another item's code field. Used to determine which item will replace this item when being generated in the NPC's store while the game is playing in Hell difficulty. If this field's code equals "xxx", then this item will not change in this difficulty.

fields.name: Nameable
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the item's name can be personalized by Anya for the Act 5 Betrayal of Harrogath quest reward. If equals 0, then the item cannot be used for the personalized name reward.

fields.name: PermStoreItem
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then this item will always appear on the NPC's store. If equals 0, then the item will randomly appear on the NPC's store when appropriate.

fields.name: EventItem
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then this item will have its named colored with the FONTCOLOR (enums) "EventItemsColor".

fields.name: UICatOverride
fields.description: Allows this item to override what UI Category it should use (for loot filter and chronicle uniques page). If there's no override, this item will belong to the category that its type1 field uses. If Null, this item will be excluded from lootfilter / chronicle. If a valid UI Category, this item will belong to that UI category instead of the one its type would usually put it in.

fields.name: diablocloneweight
fields.description: The amount of weight added to the diablo clone progress when this item is sold. When offline, selling this item will instead immediately spawn diablo clone.

armtype.title: ArmType.txt
armtype.overview:
Reference file that defines armor types.
Any column field name starting with "*" is considered a comment field and is not used by the game.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Reference field to define the armor type.

fields.name: Token
fields.description: Token used to control graphics associated item components.

automagic.title: automagic.txt
automagic.overview:
This file controls what item affixes (groups of item modifiers) are automatically applied to items, regardless of their quality type. These item affixes will not change the quality of the item. An example can be class based items like a paladin shield that can be Normal Quality but still have Paladin skill bonuses without changing the item's name.
This file is loaded together with other similar files in the following order: MagicSuffix.txt, magicprefix.txt, automagic.txt. These combined files form the Item Mods structure.
Any column field name starting with "*" is considered a comment field and is not used by the game.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Defines the item affix name.

fields.name: version
fields.description: Defines which game version to use this item affix (<100 = Classic mode | 100 = Expansion mode).

fields.name: spawnable
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then this item affix is used as part of the game's randomizer for assigning item modifiers when an item spawns. If equals 0, then this item affix is never used.

fields.name: rare
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then this item affix can be used when randomly assigning item modifiers when a rare item spawns. If equals 0, then this item affix is not used for rare items.

fields.name: level
fields.description: The minimum item level required for this item affix to spawn on the item. If the item level is below this value, then the item affix will not spawn on the item.

fields.name: maxlevel
fields.description: The maximum item level required for this item affix to spawn on the item. If the item level is above this value, then the item affix will not spawn on the item.

fields.name: levelreq
fields.description: The minimum character level required to equip an item that has this item affix

fields.name: classspecific
fields.description: Controls if this item affix should only be used for class specific items. This relies on the class code specified in Class (itemtypes), for the specific item.

fields.name: class
fields.description: Controls which character class is required for the class specific level requirement defined by classlevelreq.

fields.name: classlevelreq
fields.description: The minimum character level required for a specific class in order to equip an item that has this item affix. This relies on the class specified in the class field. If equals null, then the class will default to using the levelreq field.

fields.name: frequency
fields.description: Controls the probability that the affix appears on the item (a higher value means that the item affix will appear on the item more often). This value gets summed together with other frequency values from all possible item affixes that can spawn on the item, and then is used as a denominator value for the randomizer. Whichever item affix is randomly selected will be the one to appear on the item. The formula is calculated as the following: [Item Affix Selected] = [frequency] / [Total Frequency]. If the item has a magic level (from magic lvl (armor), magic lvl (weapons), or magic lvl (misc)) then the magic level value is multiplied with this value. If equals 0, then this item affix will never appear on an item.

fields.name: group
fields.description: Assigns an item affix to a specific group number. Items cannot spawn with more than 1 item affix with the same group number. This is used to guarantee that certain item affixes do not overlap on the same item. If this field is null, then the group number will default to group 0.

fields.name: mod#code
fields.description: Controls the item properties for the item affix.
fields.format: References a code (properties) or a code (PropertyGroups)

fields.name: mod#param
fields.description: The parameter value associated with the related property (mod#code). Usage depends on the property function (See func# (properties)).
fields.format: A number or references skill (skills), type (montype), or state (states)

fields.name: mod#min
fields.description: The min value to assign to the listed related (mod#code). Usage depends on the property function (See func# (properties)).

fields.name: mod#max
fields.description: The max value to assign to the listed related (mod#code). Usage depends on the property function (See func# (properties)).

fields.name: transformcolor
fields.description: Controls the color change of the item after spawning with this item affix. If empty, then the item affix will not change the item's color.

fields.name: itype#
fields.description: Controls what Item Types are allowed to spawn with this item affix.

fields.name: etype#
fields.description: Controls what Item Types are forbidden to spawn with this item affix.

fields.name: multiply
fields.description: Multiplicative modifier for the item's buy and sell costs, based on the item affix (Calculated in 1024ths for buy cost and 4096ths for sell cost).

fields.name: add
fields.description: Flat integer modification to the item's buy and sell costs, based on the item affix.

automap.title: AutoMap.txt
automap.overview:
This file controls how the Automap in game will display the discovered parts of the area level and store this progress in character save files. The Automap is composed of many different image files depicted as small icons to convey what part of the area level is being displayed. This file will assign these image files to their related map cells, which will properly build the Automap as the player explores the area. Not all tiles will have image files assigned to them, and in these cases, those parts of the Automap will remain blank.
Any column field name starting with "*" is considered a comment field and is not used by the game.

fields.name: LevelName
fields.description: Uses a string format system to define the Act number and name of the level type. Level types are static defined values that cannot be added. The number at the start of the string defines the Act number, and the word that follows this number defines the level type. This data should stay grouped by level.

fields.name: TileName
fields.description: Uses defined string codes to control the tile orientations on the Automap.

fields.name: Style
fields.description: Defines a group numeric ID for the range of cells, meaning that the game will try to use cells that match the same style value, after determining the Level Type and Tile Type. If this value is equal to 255, then the style is ignored in the Cel# field selection.

fields.name: StartSequence
fields.description: The start index value for valid Cel# field to choose for displaying on the Automap. If this value is equal to 255, then both the StartSequence and EndSequence are ignored in the Cel# field selection. If this value is equal to -1, then this field is ignored in the Cel# field selection.

fields.name: EndSequence
fields.description: The end index value for a valid Cel# field to choose for displaying on the Automap. If this value is equal to -1, then this field is ignored in the Cel# field selection.

fields.name: Cel#
fields.description: Determines the unique image frame to use from the MaxiMap.dc6 file that will be used to display on the Automap for that position of the level tile. There are multiple of these fields because they can be randomly chosen to give image variety in the Automap display. If the value equals -1, then this cell is not valid and will be ignored. If no cell is chosen overall, then nothing will be drawn in this area on the Automap.

belts.title: belts.txt
belts.overview:
This file controls the statistics for how belts and their various item slots work. This file relies on the belt (armor) field. Each belt entry in this file defines a belt type that controls how many slots the belt item provides. Each of these belt types are a possible value that items the belt (armor) can use. The game uses the 3rd entry is defined as the "default" belt, meaning that the player has no belt equipped, and the game will use this entry's stats to determine how to handle the belt slots.
Any column field name starting with "*" is considered a comment field and is not used by the game.

fields.name: numboxes
fields.description: This integer field defines the number of item slots in the belt. This is used when inserting items into the belt and also for handling the removal of items when the belt item is unequipped.

fields.name: box#left
fields.description: Specifies the belt slot left side coordinates. This is use for Server verification purposes and does not affect the local box UI in the client.

fields.name: box#right
fields.description: Specifies the belt slot right side coordinates. This is use for Server verification purposes and does not affect the local box UI in the client.

fields.name: box#top
fields.description: Specifies the belt slot left top coordinates. This is use for Server verification purposes and does not affect the local box UI in the client.

fields.name: box#bottom
fields.description: Specifies the belt slot bottom side coordinates. This is use for Server verification purposes and does not affect the local box UI in the client.

fields.name: defaultItemTypeCol#
fields.description: Specifies the default item type used for the populate belt and auto-use functionality on controller.

fields.name: defaultItemCodeCol#
fields.description: Specifies the default item code used for the populate belt and auto-use functionality on controller. Leaving this blank uses no code and instead relies entirely on the item type.

bodylocs.title: bodylocs.txt
bodylocs.overview:
Reference file that defines body locations.
Any column field name starting with "*" is considered a comment field and is not used by the game.

fields.name: Code
fields.description: 4 letter code associated with the body location.

books.title: books.txt
books.overview:
This file controls functionalities of book items (also called Tomes). This includes how they interact with their related scroll items.
Any column field name starting with "*" is considered a comment field and is not used by the game.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: This is a reference field to define the book.

fields.name: ScrollSpellCode
fields.description: Uses an item's code to define as the scroll item for the book.

fields.name: BookSpellCode
fields.description: Uses an item's code to define as the book item.

fields.name: pSpell
fields.description: Defines the item spell function to use when using the book. See pSpell (misc) for possible values.

fields.name: SpellIcon
fields.description: Controls which DC6 file to display for the mouse cursor when using the scroll or book (Uses numeric indices to pick the DC6 file. Example: When using Identify, use icon 1 or buysell.DC6).

fields.name: ScrollSkill
fields.description: Defines which Skill to use for the scroll item.

fields.name: BookSkill
fields.description: Defines which Skill to use for the book item.

fields.name: BaseCost
fields.description: The starting gold cost to buy the book from an NPC.

fields.name: CostPerCharge
fields.description: The additional gold cost added with the book's BaseCost value, based on how many charges the book has.

charstats.title: charstats.txt
charstats.overview:
This file controls the starting stats for each of the classes.
Any column field name starting with "*" is considered a comment field and is not used by the game.

fields.name: class
fields.description: The name of the character class (this cannot be changed).

fields.name: str
fields.description: Starting amount of the Strength attribute.

fields.name: dex
fields.description: Starting amount of the Dexterity attribute.

fields.name: int
fields.description: Starting amount of the Energy attribute.

fields.name: vit
fields.description: Starting amount of the Vitality attribute.

fields.name: stamina
fields.description: Starting amount of Stamina.

fields.name: hpadd
fields.description: Bonus starting Life value (This value gets added with the vit field value to determine the overall starting amount of Life).

fields.name: ManaRegen
fields.description: Number of seconds to regain max Mana (If this equals 0 then it will default to 300 seconds).

fields.name: ToHitFactor
fields.description: Starting amount of Attack Rating.

fields.name: WalkVelocity
fields.description: Base Walk movement speed.

fields.name: RunVelocity
fields.description: Base Run movement speed.

fields.name: RunDrain
fields.description: Rate at which Stamina is lost while running.

fields.name: LifePerLevel
fields.description: Amount of Life added for each level gained (Calculated in fourths and is divided by 256).

fields.name: StaminaPerLevel
fields.description: Amount of Stamina added for each level gained (Calculated in fourths and is divided by 256).

fields.name: ManaPerLevel
fields.description: Amount of Mana added for each level gained (Calculated in fourths and is divided by 256).

fields.name: LifePerVitality
fields.description: Amount of Life added for each point in Vitality (Calculated in fourths and is divided by 256).

fields.name: StaminaPerVitality
fields.description: Amount of Stamina added for each point in Vitality (Calculated in fourths and is divided by 256).

fields.name: ManaPerMagic
fields.description: Amount of Mana added for each point in Energy (Calculated in fourths and is divided by 256).

fields.name: StatPerLevel
fields.description: Amount of Attribute stat points earned for each level gained.

fields.name: SkillsPerLevel
fields.description: Amount of Skill points earned for each level gained.

fields.name: LightRadius
fields.description: Baseline radius size of the character's Light Radius.

fields.name: BlockFactor
fields.description: Baseline percent chance for Blocking.

fields.name: MinimumCastingDelay
fields.description: Minimum casting delay on all Skills after using a Skill with a localdelay (skills) or globaldelay (skills) (Calculated in Frames, where 25 Frames = 1 Second).

fields.name: StartSkill
fields.description: Controls what skill will be added by default to the character's starting weapon and will be slotted in the Right Skill selection.

fields.name: Skill #

difficultylevels.title: difficultylevels.txt
difficultylevels.overview:
This file controls global parameters for game rules and how they work between each difficulty mode. Users cannot add new difficulty modes from this file.
Any column field name starting with "*" is considered a comment field and is not used by the game.

fields.name: ResistPenalty
fields.description: Defines the baseline starting point for a player character's resistances for Expansion mode

fields.name: ResistPenaltyNonExpansion
fields.description: Defines the baseline starting point for a player character's resistances for Non-Expansion mode

fields.name: DeathExpPenalty
fields.description: Modifies the percentage of current level experience lost when a player character dies

fields.name: MonsterSkillBonus
fields.description: Adds additional skill levels to skills used by monsters (defined from monstats.txt)

fields.name: MonsterFreezeDivisor
fields.description: Divisor that affects all Freeze Length values on monsters. The attempted Freeze Length value is divided by this divisor to determine the actual Freeze Length.

fields.name: MonsterColdDivisor
fields.description: Divisor that affects all Cold Length values on monsters. The attempted Cold Length value is divided by this divisor to determine the actual Cold Length.

fields.name: AiCurseDivisor
fields.description: Divisor that affects all durations of Curses on monsters. The attempted Curse duration is divided by this divisor to determine the actual Curse duration.

fields.name: LifeStealDivisor
fields.description: Divisor that affects the amount of Life Steal that player characters gain. The attempted Life Steal value is divided by this divisor to determine the actual Life Steal.

fields.name: ManaStealDivisor
fields.description: Divisor that affects the amount of Mana Steal that player characters gain. The attempted Mana Steal value is divided by this divisor to determine the actual Mana Steal.

fields.name: UniqueDamageBonus
fields.description: Percentage modifier for a Unique monster's overall Damage and Attack Rating. This is applied after calculating the monster's other modifications.

fields.name: ChampionDamageBonus
fields.description: Percentage modifier for a Champion monster's overall Damage and Attack Rating. This is applied after calculating the monster's other modifications.

fields.name: PlayerDamagePercentVSPlayer
fields.description: Percentage modifier for the total damage a player deals to another player

fields.name: PlayerDamagePercentVSMercenary
fields.description: Percentage modifier for the total damage a player deals to another player's mercenary

fields.name: PlayerDamagePercentVSPrimeEvil
fields.description: Percentage modifier for the total damage a player deals to a Prime Evil boss

fields.name: PlayerHitReactBufferVSPlayer
fields.description: The frame length for the amount of time a player cannot be placed into another hit react from a player (25 frames = 1 second).

fields.name: PlayerHitReactBufferVSMonster
fields.description: The frame length for the amount of time a player cannot be placed into another hit react from a monster (25 frames = 1 second).

fields.name: MercenaryDamagePercentVSPlayer
fields.description: Percentage modifier for the total damage a player's mercenary deals to another player

fields.name: MercenaryDamagePercentVSMercenary
fields.description: Percentage modifier for the total damage a player's mercenary deals to another player's mercenary

fields.name: MercenaryDamagePercentVSBoss
fields.description: Percentage modifier for the total damage a player's mercenary deals to a boss monster

fields.name: MercenaryMaxStunLength
fields.description: The frame length for the maximum stun length allowed on a player's mercenary (25 Frames = 1 second)

fields.name: PrimeEvilDamagePercentVSPlayer
fields.description: Percentage modifier applied to the total damage a Prime Evil boss deals to a player

fields.name: PrimeEvilDamagePercentVSMercenary
fields.description: Percentage modifier for the total damage a Prime Evil boss deals to a player's mercenary

fields.name: PrimeEvilDamagePercentVSPet
fields.description: Percentage modifier for the total damage a Prime Evil boss deals to a player's pet

fields.name: PetDamagePercentVSPlayer
fields.description: Percentage modifier for the total damage a player's pet deals to another player

fields.name: MonsterCEDamagePercent
fields.description: Percentage modifier that affects how much damage is dealt to a player by a Monster's version of Corpse Explosion. For example, when certain monsters die and explode on death.

fields.name: MonsterFireEnchantExplosionDamagePercent
fields.description: Percentage modifier that affects how much damage is dealt to a player by a Monster's Fire Enchant explosion. The Fire Enchant death explosion uses the same Corpse Explosion functionality and this value is applied after the MonsterCEDamagePercent value.

fields.name: StaticFieldMin
fields.description: Percentage modifier for capping the amount of current Life damage dealt to monsters by the Sorceress Static Field skill. This field only affects games in Expansion mode.

fields.name: GambleRare
fields.description: The odds to obtain a Rare item from gambling. The game rolls a random number between 0 to 100000. If that rolled number is less than this value, then the gambled item will be a Rare item.

fields.name: GambleSet
fields.description: The odds to obtain a Set item from gambling. The game rolls a random number between 0 to 100000. If that rolled number is less than this value, then the gambled item will be a Set item.

fields.name: GambleUnique
fields.description: The odds to obtain a Unique item from gambling. The game rolls a random number between 0 to 100000. If that rolled number is less than this value, then the gambled item will be a Unique item.

fields.name: GambleUber
fields.description:
The odds to make the gambled item be an Exceptional Quality item. The game rolls a random number between 0 to 10000. This rolled number is then compared to the following formula:
([Item Level] - [Base Item Level]) * [GambleUber] + 1
If the rolled number is less than this value, then the item becomes an Exceptional Quality item, and the game will roll for upgrading it to Elite Quality (See GambleUltra).

fields.name: GambleUltra
fields.description:
The odds to make the gambled item be an Elite Quality item. The game rolls a random number between 0 to 10000. This rolled number is then compared to the following formula:
([Item Level] - [Base Item Level]) * [GambleUltra] + 1
If the rolled number is less than this value, then the item is upgraded to an Elite Quality item. This only happens if the item successfully rolled for Exceptional Quality.

fields.name: ResistFloor
fields.description: This field is currently disabled and does nothing. Sets minimum resistance a unit can have. This defaults to -100

fields.name: name

fields.name: letter
fields.description: Defines the string that is concatenated together in the item tooltip when a rune is socketed into an item

fields.name: transform

fields.name: code
fields.description: Links this entry to a specific item's code.

fields.name: Mod#Code
fields.description: Controls the item properties that the gem/rune provides when socketed into an item with a gemapplytype (misc) value that equals (weapon=0, helm=1, shield=2)
fields.format: References a code (properties) or a code (PropertyGroups)

fields.name: Mod#Param
fields.description: The stat's "parameter" value associated with the listed property. Usage depends on the property function (See func# (properties))
fields.format: A number or references skill (skills), type (montype), or state (states)

fields.name: Mod#Min
fields.description: The stat's "min" value associated with the listed property. Usage depends on the property function (See func# (properties))

fields.name: Mod#Max
fields.description: The stat's "max" value associated with the listed property. Usage depends on the property function (See func# (properties))

hireling.title: hireling.txt
hireling.overview:
This file controls the unit statistics for player mercenaries and their related functions.
Any column field name starting with "*" is considered a comment field and is not used by the game.

fields.name: Version
fields.description: Defines which game version to use this hireling (0 = Classic mode | 100 = Expansion mode)

fields.name: Id
fields.description: The unique identification number to define each hireling type

fields.name: Class
fields.description: This refers to the index in monstats.txt for the base type of unit to use for the hireling

fields.name: Act
fields.description: The Act that the hireling belongs to (values 1 to 5 equal Act 1 to Act 5, respectively)

fields.name: Difficulty
fields.description: The difficulty mode associated with the hireling (1 = Normal | 2 = Nightmare | 3 = Hell)

fields.name: Level
fields.description: The starting level of the unit

fields.name: Seller
fields.description: This refers to the index in monstats.txt which defines the unit NPC that sells this hireling

fields.name: NameFirst
fields.description: Defines a string key which the game uses as a sequential range of string IDs from NameFirst to NameLast to randomly generate as hireling names. (Max name length is 48 characters)

fields.name: Gold
fields.description: The initial cost of the hireling. This is used in the following calculation to generate the full hire price: Cost = [Gold] * (100 + 15 * [Difference of Current Level and Level]) / 100

fields.name: Exp/Lvl
fields.description: This modifier is used in the following calculation to determine the amount of Experience need for the hireling's next level: [Current Level] + [Current Level] * [Current Level + 1] * [Exp/Lvl]

fields.name: HP
fields.description: The starting amount of Life at base Level

fields.name: HP/Lvl
fields.description: The amount of Life gained per Level

fields.name: Defense
fields.description: The starting amount of Defense at base Level

fields.name: Def/Lvl
fields.description: The amount of Defense gained per Level

fields.name: Str
fields.description: The starting amount of Strength at base Level

fields.name: Str/Lvl
fields.description: The amount of Strength gained per Level (Calculated in 8ths)

fields.name: Dex
fields.description: The starting amount of Dexterity at base Level

fields.name: Dex/Lvl
fields.description: The amount of Dexterity gained per Level (Calculated in 8ths)

fields.name: AR
fields.description: The starting amount of Attack Rating at base Level

fields.name: AR/Lvl
fields.description: The amount of Attack Rating gained per Level

fields.name: Dmg-Min
fields.description: The starting amount of minimum Physical Damage for attacks

fields.name: Dmg-Max
fields.description: The starting amount of maximum Physical Damage for attacks

fields.name: Dmg/Lvl
fields.description: The amount of Physical Damage gained per level, to be added to Dmg-Min and Dmg-Max (Calculated in 8ths)

fields.name: ResistFire
fields.description: The starting amount of Fire Resistance at base Level

fields.name: ResistFire/Lvl
fields.description: The amount of Fire Resistance gained per Level (Calculated in 4ths)

fields.name: ResistCold
fields.description: The starting amount of Cold Resistance at base Level

fields.name: ResistCold/Lvl
fields.description: The amount of Cold Resistance gained per Level (Calculated in 4ths)

fields.name: ResistLightning
fields.description: The starting amount of Lightning Resistance at base Level

fields.name: ResistLightning/Lvl
fields.description: The amount of Lightning Resistance gained per Level (Calculated in 4ths)

fields.name: ResistPoison
fields.description: The starting amount of Poison Resistance at base Level

fields.name: ResistPoison/Lvl
fields.description: The amount of Poison Resistance gained per Level (Calculated in 4ths)

fields.name: HireDesc
fields.description: This accepts a string key, which is used to display as the special description of the hireling in the hire UI window

fields.name: DefaultChance
fields.description: This is the chance for the hireling to attack with their weapon instead of using a Skill. All Chance values are summed together as a denominator value for a random roll to determine which skill to use.

fields.name: Skill#
fields.description: This gives the hireling a Skill to use (requires Mode#, Chance#, ChancePerLvl#)

fields.name: Mode#
fields.description: Uses a monster mode to determine the hireling's behavior when using the related Skill (Corresponds to name (MonMode), use the numeric ID)

fields.name: Chance#
fields.description: This is the base chance for the hireling to use the related Skill. All Chance values are summed together as a denominator value for a random roll to determine which skill to use.

fields.name: ChancePerLvl#
fields.description: This is the chance for the hireling to use the related Skill, affected by the difference in the hireling's current Level and the hireling's Level field. All Chance values are summed together as a denominator value for a random roll to determine which skill to use. Each skill Chance is calculated with the following formula: [Chance#] + [ChancePerLvl#] * [Difference of Current Level and Level] / 4

fields.name: Level#
fields.description: The starting Level for the related Skill.

fields.name: LvlPerLvl#
fields.description: A modifier to increase the related Skill level for every Level gained. This is used in the following calculated to determine the current skill level: [Current Skill Level] = FLOOR([Level#] + (([LvlPerLvl#] * [Difference of Current Level and Level]) / 32))

fields.name: HiringMaxLevelDifference
fields.description: This is used to generate a range with this value plus and minus with the player's current Level. In the hiring UI window, hirelings start with a random Level that is between this range.

fields.name: resurrectcostmultiplier
fields.description: A modifier used to calculate the hireling's current resurrect cost. Used in the following formula: [Resurrect Cost] = [Current Level] * [Current Level] / [resurrectcostdivisor] * [resurrectcostmultiplier]

fields.name: resurrectcostdivisor
fields.description: A modifier used to calculate the hireling's current resurrect cost. Used in the following formula: [Resurrect Cost] = [Current Level] * [Current Level] / [resurrectcostdivisor] * [resurrectcostmultiplier]

fields.name: resurrectcostmax
fields.description: This is the maximum Gold cost to resurrect this hireling

fields.name: equivalentcharclass
fields.description: Determines what class this hireling is treated like under the hood when calculating skill level bonuses and gear restrictions.
