missiles.title: Missiles.txt
missiles.overview:
This file controls the different functions for all missiles and their statistics. Missiles are projectiles used throughout the game for attacks, skills, and special effects.
Any column field name starting with "*" is considered a comment field and is not used by the game.

fields.name: Vel
fields.description: The baseline velocity of the missile, which is the speed at which the missile moves in the game world. This is measured by distance in pixels traveled per frame.

fields.name: MaxVel
fields.description: The maximum velocity of the missile. If the missile's current velocity increases (based on other fields), then this field controls how high the velocity is allowed to go.

fields.name: VelLev
fields.description: Adds extra velocity based on the caster unit's level. Each level gained beyond level 1 will add this value to the baseline Vel field.

fields.name: Accel
fields.description: Controls the acceleration of the missile's movement. A positive value will increase the missile's velocity per frame. A negative value will decrease the missile's velocity per frame. The bigger positive or negative values will cause the velocity to change faster per frame.

fields.name: Range
fields.description: Controls the duration that the missile will exist for after it is created. This is measured in frames where 25 Frames = 1 second. Note that there are some instances where a skill function will overwrite this.
fields.format: Missile scope BBE. See BBE/Calc Fields

fields.name: Radius
fields.description: Specify the radius of the missile. This is different from its size. The radius is used for missile function searches and for vfx rendering. The size is used for collision and overlap checks.
fields.format: Missile scope BBE. See BBE/Calc Fields

fields.name: Light
fields.description: Controls the missile's Light Radius size (measured in grid sub-tiles)

fields.name: Flicker
fields.description: If greater than 0, then every 4th frame while the missile is active, the Light Radius will randomly change in size between base size to its base size plus this value (measured in grid sub-tiles)

fields.name: Red
fields.description: Controls the red color value of the missile's Light Radius (Uses a value from 0 to 255)

fields.name: Green
fields.description: Controls the green color value of the monster's Light Radius (Uses a value from 0 to 255)

fields.name: Blue
fields.description: Controls the blue color value of the monster's Light Radius (Uses a value from 0 to 255)

fields.name: InitSteps
fields.description: The number of frames the missile needs to be alive until it becomes visible on the game client. If the missile's current duration in frame count is less than this value, then the missile will appear invisible.

fields.name: Activate
fields.description: The number of frames the missile needs to be alive until it becomes active. If the missile's current duration in frame count is less than this value, then the missile will not collide.

fields.name: LoopAnim
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the missile's animation will repeat once the previous animation finishes. If equals 0, then the missile's animation will only play once, which can cause the missile to appear invisible at the end of the animation, but it will still be alive.

fields.name: CelFile
fields.description: Defines which DCC missile file to use for the visual graphics of the missile

fields.name: animrate
fields.description: Controls the visual speed of the missile's animation graphics. The overall missile animation rate is calculated as the following: 256 * [animrate] / 1024

fields.name: AnimLen
fields.description: Defines the length of the missile's animation in frames where 25 Frames = 1 second. This field can sometimes be used to calculate the missile animation rate, depending on the missile function used.

fields.name: AnimSpeed
fields.description: Controls the visual speed of the missile's animation graphics on the client side (Measured in 16ths, where 16 equals 1 frame per second). This can be overridden by certain missile functions.

fields.name: RandStart
fields.description: If this value is greater than 0, then the missile will start at a random frame between 0 and this value when it begins its animation.

fields.name: SubLoop
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the missile will use a specific sequence of its animation while it is alive, depending on its creation. If equals 0, then the missile will not use a sequenced animation.

fields.name: SubStart
fields.description: The starting frame of the sequence animation. This requires that the SubLoop field is enabled.

fields.name: SubStop
fields.description: The ending frame of the sequence animation. After reaching this frame, then the sequenced animation will loop back to the SubStart frame. This requires that the SubLoop field is enabled.

fields.name: CollideType
fields.description: Defines the missile's collision type, which controls what units, objects, or parts of the environment that the missile can impact
table: Player, Monster, Barrier, and Wall collision

fields.name: CollideKill
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the missile will be destroyed when it collides with something. If equals 0, then the missile will not be destroyed when it collides with something.

fields.name: CollideFriend
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the missile can collide with friendly units, including the caster. If equals 0, then the missile will ignore friendly units.

fields.name: LastCollide
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the missile will track the last unit that it collided with, which is useful for making sure the missile does not hit the same unit twice. If equals 0, then ignore this.

fields.name: Collision
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the missile will have a missile type path placement collision mask when it is initialized or moved. If equals 0, then the missile will have no placement collision mask when it is created or moved.

fields.name: ClientCol
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the missile will check collision on the client, depending on the missile's CollideType field. If equals 0, then ignore this.

fields.name: CollisionOverlap
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then an overlap collision check is done on the current missile location before stepping the missile on its next path location.

fields.name: ClientSend
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the server will create the missile on the client. This can be used when reloading area levels or transitioning units between areas. If equals 0, then ignore this.

fields.name: NextHit
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the missile will use the next delay. If equals 0, then ignore this.

fields.name: NextDelay
fields.description: Controls the delay in frame length until this and any other missiles from the same skill cast are allowed to hit the same unit again. This field relies on the NextHit field being enabled.

fields.name: xoffset
fields.description: Specifies the X, Y, and Z location coordinates (measured in pixels) to offset to visually draw the missile based on its actual location. This will only offset the visual graphics of the missile, not the missile itself. The Z axis controls the visual height of the missile.

fields.name: Size
fields.description: Defines the diameter in sub-tiles (for both the X and Y axis) that the missile will occupy. This affects how the missile will collide with something or how the game will handle placement for the missile.

fields.name: SrcTown
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the missile will be destroyed if the caster unit is located in an act town. If equals 0, then ignore this.

fields.name: CltSrcTown
fields.description: If this value is greater than 0 and the LoopAnim field is disabled, then this field will control which frame to set the missile's animation when the player is in town. This value gets subtracted from the AnimLen value to determine the frame to set the missile's animation.

fields.name: CanDestroy
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the missile can be attacked and destroyed. If equals 0, then the missile cannot be attacked.

fields.name: ToHit
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then this missile will use the caster's Attack Rating stat to determine if the missile should hit its target. If equals 0, then the missile will always hit its target.

fields.name: AlwaysExplode
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the missile will always process an explosion when it is killed, which can use a server hit function (See pSrvHitFunc) and can use the HitSound and ExplosionMissile fields on the client side. If equals 0, then the missile will only rely on proper collision hits to process an explosion.

fields.name: Explosion
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the missile will be classified as an explosion which will make it use different handlers for finding nearby units and dealing damage. If equals 0, then ignore this.

fields.name: Town
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the missile is allowed to be alive when in a town area. If equals 0, then the missile will be immediately destroyed when located within a town area.

fields.name: NoUniqueMod
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the missile will not receive bonuses from Unique monster modifiers. If equals 0, then the missile will receive bonuses from Unique monster modifiers.

fields.name: NoMultiShot
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the missile will not be affected by the Multi-Shot monster modifier. If equals 0, then the missile will be affected by the Multi-Shot monster modifier.

fields.name: Holy
fields.description: Controls a bit field flag where each value is a code to allow the missile to damage a certain type of monster. Leave blank to damage all units.

fields.name: CanSlow
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the missile can be affected by the "slowmissiles" state (See states.txt). If equals 0, then the missile will ignore the "slowmissiles" state.

fields.name: ReturnFire
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then missile can trigger the Sorceress Chilling Armor event function. If equals 0, then this missile will not trigger that function.

fields.name: GetHit
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the missile will cause the target unit to enter the Get Hit mode (GH), which acts as the hit recovery mode. If equals 0, then ignore this.

fields.name: SoftHit
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the missile will cause a soft hit on the unit, which can trigger a blood splatter effect, hit flash, and/or a hit sound. If equals 0, then ignore this.

fields.name: KnockBack
fields.description: Controls the percentage chance (out of 100) that the target unit will be knocked back when hit by the missile

fields.name: Trans
fields.description: Controls the alpha mode for how the missile is displayed, which can affect transparency and blending

fields.name: Pierce
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then allow the Pierce modifier function to work with this missile. If equals 0, then do not allow Pierce to work with this missile.

fields.name: MissileSkill
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the missile will look up the skill that created it and use that skill's damage instead of the missile damage. If equals 0, then ignore this.

fields.name: Skill
fields.description: This will look up the specified skill's damage and use it for the missile instead of using the missile's defined damage.

fields.name: ResultFlags
fields.description: Controls different flags that can affect how the target reacts after being hit by the missile. Uses an integer value to check against different bit fields by using the "&" operator. For example, if the value equals 5 (binary = 101) then that returns true for both the 4 (binary = 100) and 1 (binary = 1) bit field values.

fields.name: HitFlags
fields.description: Controls different flags that can affect the damage dealt when the target is hit by the missile. Uses an integer value to check against different bit fields by using the "&" operator. For example, if the value equals 6 (binary = 110) then that returns true for both the 4 (binary = 100) and 2 (binary = 10) bit field values.

fields.name: HitShift
fields.description: Controls the percentage modifier for the missile's damage. This value cannot be less than 0 or greater than 8. This is calculated in 256ths, where 8=256/256, 7=128/256, 6=64/256, 5=32/256, 4=16/256, 3=8/256, 2=4/256, 1=2/256, and 0=1/256.

fields.name: ApplyMastery
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then apply the caster's elemental mastery bonus modifiers to the missile's elemental damage. If equals 0, then ignore this.

fields.name: SrcDamage
fields.description: Controls how much of the source unit's damage should be added to the missile's damage. This is calculated in 128ths and acts as a percentage modifier for the source unit's damage that added to the missile. If equals -1 or 0, then the source damage is not included.

fields.name: Half2HSrc
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1 and the source unit is currently wielding a 2-Handed weapon, then the source damage (see SrcDamage) is reduced by 50%. If equals 0, then ignore this.

fields.name: SrcMissDmg
fields.description: If the missile was created by another missile, then this controls how much of the source missile's damage should be added to this missile's damage. This is calculated in 128ths and acts as a percentage modifier for the source missile's damage that added to this missile. If equals 0, then the source damage is not included.

fields.name: MinDamage
fields.description: Minimum baseline physical damage dealt by the missile

fields.name: MinLevDam#
fields.description: Controls the additional minimum physical damage dealt by the missile, calculated using the leveling formula between 5 level thresholds of the missile's current level. The level thresholds are levels 2-8, 9-16, 17-22, 23-28, 29 and beyond. These 5 level thresholds correlate to each field.

fields.name: MaxDamage
fields.description: Maximum baseline physical damage dealt by the missile

fields.name: MaxLevDam#
fields.description: Controls the additional maximum physical damage dealt by the missile, calculated using the leveling formula between 5 level thresholds of the missile's current level. The level thresholds are levels 2-8, 9-16, 17-22, 23-28, 29 and beyond. These 5 level thresholds correlate to each field.

fields.name: DmgSymPerCalc
fields.description: Calculation Field. Determines the percentage increase to the physical damage dealt by the missile based on specified skill levels.
fields.format: Missile scope BBE. See BBE/Calc Fields

fields.name: EType
fields.description: Defines the type of elemental damage dealt by the missile. If this field is empty, then the related elemental fields below will not be used. Any type that has length uses the ELen field.

fields.name: EMin
fields.description: Minimum baseline elemental damage dealt by the missile

fields.name: MinELev#
fields.description: Controls the additional minimum elemental damage dealt by the missile, calculated using the leveling formula between 5 level thresholds of the missile's current level. The level thresholds are levels 2-8, 9-16, 17-22, 23-28, 29 and beyond. These 5 level thresholds correlate to each field number.

fields.name: EMax
fields.description: Maximum baseline elemental damage dealt by the missile

fields.name: MaxELev#
fields.description: Controls the additional maximum elemental damage dealt by the missile, calculated using the leveling formula between 5 level thresholds of the missile's current level. The level thresholds are levels 2-8, 9-16, 17-22, 23-28, 29 and beyond. These 5 level thresholds correlate to each field.

fields.name: EDmgSymPerCalc
fields.description: Calculation Field. Determines the percentage increase to the elemental damage dealt by the missile based on specified skill levels.
fields.format: Missile scope BBE. See BBE/Calc Fields

fields.name: ELen
fields.description: The baseline elemental duration dealt by the missile. This is calculated in frame lengths where 25 Frames = 1 second. These fields only apply to appropriate elemental types with a duration.

fields.name: ELevLen#
fields.description: Controls the additional elemental duration added by the missile, calculated using the leveling formula between 3 level thresholds of the missile's current level. The level thresholds are levels 2-8, 9-16, 17 and beyond. These 3 level thresholds correlate to each field. These fields only apply to appropriate elemental types with a duration.

fields.name: HitClass
fields.description: Defines the missil's own hit class into the damage routines, mainly used for determining hit sound effects and overlays. This field only handles the hit class layers, so values beyond these defined bits are ignored. Uses an integer value to check against different bit fields by using the "&" operator. For example, if the value equals 6 (binary = 110) then that returns true for both the 4 (binary = 100) and 2 (binary = 10) bit field values.

fields.name: NumDirections
fields.description: The number of directions allowed by the missile, based on the DCC file used (see CelFile). This value should be within the power of 2, with a minimum value of 1 or up to a maximum value of 64.

fields.name: LocalBlood
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then change the color of blood missiles to green. If equals 0, then keep the blood missiles colored the default red.

fields.name: DamageRate
fields.description: Controls the "damage_framerate" stat (Calculated in 1024ths), which acts as a percentage multiplier for the physical damage reduction and magic damage reduction stat modifiers, when performing damage resistance calculations. This is only enabled if the value is greater than 0.

fields.name: TravelSound
fields.description: Used when the missile is created and while it is alive.

fields.name: HitSound
fields.description: Used when the collides with a target.

fields.name: OnDiedSound
fields.description: Optional sound to play when the missile dies.

fields.name: ProgSound
fields.description: Used for a programmed special event based on the client function.

fields.name: ProgOverlay
fields.description: Used for a programmed special event based on the server or client function.

fields.name: ExplosionMissile
fields.description: Used for the missile created on the client when this missile explodes.

fields.name: SubMissile#
fields.description: Used for creating a new missile based on the server function used.

fields.name: HitSubMissile#
fields.description: Used for a new missile after a collision, based on the server function used.

fields.name: CltSubMissile#
fields.description: Used for creating a new missile based on the client function used.

fields.name: CltHitSubMissile#
fields.description: Used for a new missile after a collision, based on the client function used.

fields.name: MissileWeaponVFX
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the missile is being represented by a weapon or a vfx based on a weapon.

monai.title: monai.txt
monai.overview:
Reference file that defines AI behaviors that monsters can use.
Any column field name starting with "*" is considered a comment field and is not used by the game.

fields.name: AI
fields.description: Name of the AI behavior

moncalc.title: moncalc.txt
moncalc.overview:
Reference file that defines identifiers for monster scope BBE functions. See BBE/Calc Fields.
Any column field name starting with "*" is considered a comment field and is not used by the game.

fields.name: code
fields.description: 4 letter abbreviation for the identifier.

monequip.title: monequip.txt
monequip.overview:
This file controls how a monster may be created with specific type of inventory equipment items. These equipment items are randomly generated on the monster, based on the specified parameters in this file. This data relies on the inventory (monstats) field being enabled for the listed monster.
Any column field name starting with "*" is considered a comment field and is not used by the game.

fields.name: monster
fields.description: Defines the monster that should be equipped. If the monster has multiple defined equipment possibilities, then they should always be grouped together. The game will go through the list in order to match what is best to use for the monster.

fields.name: oninit
fields.description: Defines if the monster equipment is added on initialization during the monster's creation, depending how the monster is spawned. Monsters created by a skill have this value set to 0. Monsters created by a level have this value set to 1.

fields.name: level
fields.description: Defines the level requirement for the monster in order to gain this equipment. The game will prefer the highest level allowed, so the order of these equipment should be from highest level to lowest level.

fields.name: item#
fields.description: Item that the be equipped on the monster (Uses an item code)

fields.name: loc#
fields.description: Specifies the inventory slot where the item will be equipped. Once an item is equipped on that body location, then the game will skip any duplicate calls to equipping the same body location. This is another reason why the equipment should be ordered from highest level to lowest level.

fields.name: mod#
fields.description: Controls the quality level of the related item. Anything after "Crafted" is not allowed.

monlvl.title: MonLvl.txt
monlvl.overview:
This file controls how monster statistics increase per level based on the current game type and difficulty.
The "(N" text in field names signifies to use that specific value for games in Nightmare difficulty. The "(H)" text in field names signifies to use that specific value for games in Hell difficulty.
"L-" signifies the field is used for Ladder Battle.net game types, otherwise its used for Non-Ladder Battle.net / Singleplay / Open Battle.net / TCP.
Any column field name starting with "*" is considered a comment field and is not used by the game.

fields.name: AC
fields.description: Percentage multiplier for increasing the Monster's Defense (multiplies with the AC (monstats)).

fields.name: TH
fields.description: Percentage multiplier for increasing the Monster's Attack Rating (multiplies with the A1TH (monstats) and A2TH (monstats) fields)

fields.name: HP
fields.description: Percentage multiplier for increasing the Monster's Life (multiplies with the minHP (monstats) and maxHP (monstats) fields)

fields.name: DM
fields.description: Percentage multiplier for increasing the Monster's Damage (multiplies with the A1MinD (monstats), A2MinD (monstats), S1MinD (monstats) and A1MaxD (monstats), A2MaxD (monstats), S1MaxD (monstats) fields)

fields.name: XP
fields.description: Percentage multiplier for increasing the Experience provided to the player when killing the Monster (multiplies with the Exp (monstats) fields)

monmode.title: MonMode.txt
monmode.overview:
Reference file that defines the modes that monster units can use.
Any column field name starting with "*" is considered a comment field and is not used by the game.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Reference name for the mode

fields.name: token
fields.description: 2 letter abbreviation of the mode. Used by graphics.

fields.name: code
fields.description: 2 letter abbreviation of the mode. Used by other data tables.

monpet.title: MonPet.txt
monpet.overview:
Controls data associated with specific monsters when they become a player's pet.
Any column field name starting with "*" is considered a comment field and is not used by the game.

fields.name: monster
fields.description: What monster this MonPet entry connects to.
fields.format: References a Id (monstats) or a Superunique (superuniques)

fields.name: hirelingAlternateVoice
fields.description: Boolean field. If equals 1, then the hireling will use the alternate (feminine) voice type for voice lines. If equals 0, then it will use the masculine voice type.

fields.name: consumestat#
fields.description: Stat to add when this monster is consumed using srv-WarStartConsume (skills).

fields.name: consumepar#
fields.description: Parameter for the associated consumestat#.
fields.format: A number or references skill (skills), type (montype), or state (states)

fields.name: consumecalc#
fields.description: The value for the associated consumestat#.
fields.format: Monster scope BBE. See BBE/Calc Fields

fields.name: numunderlingcalc
fields.description: The maximum amount of underlings a monster can have. Underlings are currently restricted to monsters bound by WarDoBindDemon (skills).
fields.format: Monster scope BBE. See BBE/Calc Fields

fields.name: bindchancecalc
fields.description: The calculated chance a monster can be successfully bound when using WarDoBindDemon (skills).
fields.format: Monster scope BBE. See BBE/Calc Fields

monplace.title: MonPlace.txt
monplace.overview:
Reference file that defines special case groups of units to be placed in a level.
Any column field name starting with "*" is considered a comment field and is not used by the game.

fields.name: code
fields.description: Name of the special case.

monpreset.title: MonPreset.txt
monpreset.overview:
This file controls which monsters are preloaded in a preset, based on the Act number.
Any column field name starting with "*" is considered a comment field and is not used by the game.

fields.name: Act
fields.description: Defines the Act number used for each Monster Preset. Uses values between 1 to 5.

fields.name: Place
fields.description: This defines the Monster Preset which is used for preloading, such as during level transitions
fields.format: Reference of a Superunique (superuniques), Id (monstats), or code (MonPlace)

monprop.title: MonProp.txt
monprop.overview:
This file controls special properties that can be added to a monster, based on the game difficulty.
The "(N)" text in field names signifies to use that specific value for games in Nightmare difficulty. The "(H)" text in field names signifies to use that specific value for games in Hell difficulty.
Any column field name starting with "*" is considered a comment field and is not used by the game.

fields.name: Id
fields.description: Defines the monster property that is reference by other data files.

fields.name: prop#
fields.description: Defines which Property to apply to the monster
fields.format: Reference of code (properties) or code (PropertyGroups)

fields.name: chance#
fields.description: The percent chance that the related prop# will be assigned. If this value equals 0, then the Property will always be applied.

fields.name: par#
fields.description: The "parameter" value associated with the related prop#. Usage depends on the property function (See func# (properties))

fields.name: min#
fields.description: The "min" value to assign to the related prop#. Usage depends on the property function (See func# (properties))

fields.name: max#
fields.description: The "max" value to assign to the related prop#. Usage depends on the property function (See func# (properties))

monseq.title: monseq.txt
monseq.overview:
This file controls the sequence table used for specifying events during certain animation frames, such as when using skills. A sequence is divided into multiple lines in this file to define each frame in the animation and to determine which event to use during a specific frame.
Any column field name starting with "*" is considered a comment field and is not used by the game.

fields.name: sequence
fields.description: Establishes the Monster Sequence index. An entire monster sequence can be composed of multiple sequence lines, which means that each line needs to have matching sequence fields and must be in contiguous order.

fields.name: mode
fields.description: Defines which monster mode animation to use for the sequence. (Corresponds to code (MonMode))

fields.name: frame
fields.description: The in-game frame number for the animation. For the first line in the sequence, this value will establish where the starting frame for the animation. These values should be in contiguous order for the sequence.

fields.name: dir
fields.description: Defines the numeric animation direction that the frame use. Most animations have between 8 to 64 maximum directions.

fields.name: event
fields.description: Defines what type of event will be used when the frame triggers

monsounds.title: monsounds.txt
monsounds.overview:
This file controls the sounds that play for each of a monster's actions.
Any column field name starting with "*" is considered a comment field and is not used by the game.

fields.name: Id
fields.description: Defines the unique name ID for the monster sound

fields.name: Attack#
fields.description: Play this sound when the monster performs Attack 1 and Attack 2, respectively.

fields.name: Weapon#
fields.description: Play this sound when the monster performs Attack 1 and Attack 2, respectively. This acts as an extra sound that can play with the corresponding Attack# sounds.

fields.name: Att#Del
fields.description: Controls the amount of game frames to delay playing the corresponding Attack# sounds.

fields.name: Wea#Del
fields.description: Controls the amount of game frames to delay playing the corresponding Weapon# sounds.

fields.name: Att#Prb
fields.description: Controls the percent chance (out of 100) to play the corresponding Attack# sounds.

fields.name: Wea#Vol
fields.description: Controls the volume of the corresponding Weapon# sounds. Uses a range between 0 to 255, where 255 is the maximum volume.

fields.name: HitSound
fields.description: Play this sound when the monster gets hit or knocked back.

fields.name: DeathSound
fields.description: Play this sound when the monster dies.

fields.name: HitDelay
fields.description: Controls the amount of game frames to delay playing the HitSound sound

fields.name: DeaDelay
fields.description: Controls the amount of game frames to delay playing the DeathSound sound

fields.name: Skill#
fields.description: Play this sound when the monster uses the skill linked in the related Skill# (monstats) field.

fields.name: Footstep
fields.description: Play this sound while the monster is walking or running.

fields.name: FootstepLayer
fields.description: Play this sound while the monster is walking or running. This acts as an extra sound that can play with the Footstep sound.

fields.name: FsCnt
fields.description: Controls the footstep count which is used to determine how often to play the Footstep and FootstepLayer sound. A higher value would mean that the sounds would play more often.

fields.name: FsOff
fields.description: Controls the footstep offset which is used for calculating when to play the next Footstep and FootstepLayer sound, based on the current animation frame and the animation rate. A higher value would mean that the sounds would play less often.

fields.name: FsPrb
fields.description: Controls the probability to play the Footstep and FootstepLayer sound, with a random chance out of 100.

fields.name: Neutral
fields.description: Play this sound while the monster is in Neutral, Walk, or Run mode. Also play this sound when the Id (monstats) equals "vulture1" and while the monster is in Skill1 mode. Also play this sound when the Id (monstats) equals "batdemon1" and while the monster is in Skill4 mode.

fields.name: NeuTime
fields.description: Controls the amount of game frames to delay between re-playing the Neutral sound after it finishes.

fields.name: Init
fields.description: Play this sound when the monster spawns and is not dead and is not playing its Neutral sound.

fields.name: Taunt
fields.description: Play this sound when the server requests that the monster should play its Taunt. This is typically used for quest or story related moments.

fields.name: Flee
fields.description: Play this sound when the monster is told to flee. This depends on when the monster AI is told to play this sound.

fields.name: CvtMo#
fields.description: This is used to convert the mode for playing the sound. This field defines the original mode that the monster is using. Uses a code (MonMode).

fields.name: CvtSk#
fields.description: Defines the skill that the monster is using. If the monster uses a specific skill, then the game can change the monster's mode for sound functionalities to another mode to change how sounds are generally handled.

fields.name: CvtTgt#
fields.description: Defines the mode to convert the sound to when the monster is using the relative skill from the CvtSk# field. This does not actually change the monster's actual mode but only what mode that sounds think the monster is using. Uses a code (MonMode).

monstats.title: monstats.txt
monstats.overview:
This file controls the main functionalities and statistics for every monster in the game. This includes enemy monsters, pets, and NPC units.
The "(N)" text in field names signifies to use that specific value for games in Nightmare difficulty. The "(H)" text in field names signifies to use that specific value for games in Hell difficulty.
Any column field name starting with "*" is considered a comment field and is not used by the game.

fields.name: Id
fields.description: Controls the unique name ID to define the monster.

fields.name: BaseId
fields.description: Points to the Id of another monster to define the monster's base type. This is to create groups of monsters which are considered the same type.

fields.name: NextInClass
fields.description: Points to the Id of another monster to signify the next monster in the group of this monster's type. This is to continue the groups of monsters which are considered the same type. The order should be contiguous.

fields.name: TransLvl
fields.description: Defines the color transform level to use for this monster, which affects what color palette that the monster will use

fields.name: NameStr
fields.description: String Key. Used to define the monster's name, such as in the Life bar UI when it is being targeted.

fields.name: MonStatsEx
fields.description: Controls a pointer to the monstats2.txt entry to use for this monster.

fields.name: MonProp
fields.description: Points to a Id (MonProp) field. Used to add special modifiers to the monster.

fields.name: montype
fields.description: Points to a type (montype) field. Used to handle the monster's classification.

fields.name: AI
fields.description: Points to a type of AI script to use for the monster (See monai.txt).

fields.name: DescStr
fields.description: String Key. Used to add a string to appear as an additional description below the Life bar UI when the monster is being targeted.

fields.name: Code
fields.description: Controls the token used for choosing the proper cells to display the monster's graphics

fields.name: enabled
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then this monster is allowed to spawn in the game. If equals 0, then this monster will never spawn in the game.

fields.name: rangedtype
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the monster will be classified as a ranged type. If equals 0, then the monster will be classified as a melee type.

fields.name: placespawn
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then this monster will be treated as a spawner, so monsters that spawn can be initially placed within this monster. If equals 0, then ignore this.

fields.name: spawn
fields.description: Points to the Id of another monster to control what kind of monster is spawned from this monster. This is only used if the placespawn field is enabled.

fields.name: spawnx
fields.description: Controls the X & Y offsets for where another monster is displaced when being spawned by this monster.

fields.name: spawnmode
fields.description: Defines the animation mode that the spawned monsters will be initiated with. Uses code (MonMode)

fields.name: minion#
fields.description: Points to the Id of another monster to control what kind of monster is spawned with this monster when it is spawned, like a monster pack. The minion1 field is also used for spawning a monster when this monster is killed while it has the SplEndDeath field enabled.

fields.name: SetBoss
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then set the monster AI to use the Boss AI type, which can affect the monster's behaviors. If equals 0, then ignore this.

fields.name: BossXfer
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the monste's AI will transfer its boss recognition to another monster, which can affect the minion monster behaviors after this boss is killed. If equals 0, then ignore no boss AI will transfer and minion monsters will behave differently after the boss is killed. This field relies on the SetBoss field being enabled.

fields.name: PartyMin
fields.description: The minimum and maximum number of minions that can spawn with this monster. Uses the minion# fields. The actual number is a random value chosen between the PartyMin and PartyMax field values.

fields.name: MinGrp
fields.description: The minimum and maximum number of duplicates of this monster that can spawn together. The actual number is a random value chosen between the MinGrp and #$#MaxGrp!$ field values.

fields.name: sparsePopulate
fields.description: If this value is greater than 0, then it controls the percent chance that this monster does not spawn, and another monster will spawn in its place. (Out of 100)

fields.name: Velocity
fields.description: Determines the movement velocity of the monster, which can be the monster's baseline walk speed.

fields.name: Run
fields.description: Determines the run speed of the monster as opposed to walk speed. This is only used if the monster has a Run mode.

fields.name: Rarity
fields.description: Modifies the chance that this monster will be chosen to spawn in the area level. The higher the value is, then the more likely this monster will be chosen. This value acts as a numerator and a denominator. All Rarity values of possible monsters get summed together to give a total denominator, used for the random roll. For example, if there are 3 possible monsters that can spawn, and their Rarity values are 1, 2, 2, then their chances to be chosen are 1/5, 2/5, and 2/5 respectively. If this value equals 0, then this monster is never randomly selected to spawn in an area level.

fields.name: Level
fields.description: Determines the monster's level. This value for Nightmare and Hell difficulty can be overridden by the area level's MonLvl (levels) or MonLvlEx (levels) value, unless the monster's boss and noRatio fields are enabled or the monster is desecrated (terrorized).

fields.name: MonSound
fields.description: Points to a Id (monsounds). This is used to control the monsters assigned sounds, when the monster is spawned as a Normal monster.

fields.name: UMonSound
fields.description: Points to a Id (monsounds). This is used to control the monsters assigned sounds, when the monster is spawned as a Unique or Champion monster.

fields.name: threat
fields.description: Controls the AI threat value of the monster which can affect the targeting priorities of enemy Ais for this monster. The higher this value is, then the more likely that enemy AI will target this monster.

fields.name: aidel
fields.description: Controls the delay in frame length for how often the monster's AI will update its commands. A lower delay means that the monster will perform commands more often without as long of a pause in between.

fields.name: aidist
fields.description: Controls the maximum distance (measured in tiles) between the monster and an enemy until the monster's AI becomes aggressive. If equals 0, then default to 35.

fields.name: aip#
fields.description: Defines numeric parameters used to control various functions of the monster's AI. These fields depend on which AI script is being used (See monai.txt, and the AI field)

fields.name: Miss
fields.description: Which missile to use when the monster is in the corresponding mode

fields.name: Align
fields.description: Controls the monster's alignment, which determines if the monster will be an enemy, ally, or neutral party to the player.
table: Evil Alignment - The monster will attack the player
Good Alignment - The monster will fight with the player and will be in the player's party
Neutral Alignment - The monster will not attack the player and will not be in the player's party

fields.name: isSpawn
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the monster is allowed to spawn in an area level. If equals 0, then the monster will not be spawned automatically in an area level.

fields.name: isMelee
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the monster is classified as a melee only type, which can affect its AI behaviors and what monster modifiers are allowed on the monster. If equals 0, then ignore this.

fields.name: npc
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the monster is classified as an NPC (Non-Playable Character), which can affect its AI behaviors and how the player treats this monster. If equals 0, then ignore this.

fields.name: interact
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the monster is interactable, meaning that the player can click on the monster to perform an interact command instead of attacking. If equals 0, then ignore this.

fields.name: inventory
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then monster will have an inventory with randomly generated items, such as an NPC with shop items (if the interact field is enabled) or a summoned unit with random equipped items (also see monequip.txt). If equals 0, then ignore this.

fields.name: inTown
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the monster is allowed to be in town. If equals 0, then the monster is not allowed to be in town, which can affect or disable their AI or collision from entering towns.

fields.name: lUndead
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the monster is treated as a Low Undead, meaning that the monster is classified as an Undead type and can be resurrected by certain AI. If equals 0, then ignore this.

fields.name: hUndead
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the monster is treated as a High Undead, meaning that the monster is classified as an Undead type but cannot be resurrected by certain AI. If equals 0, then ignore this.

fields.name: demon
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the monster is classified as a Demon type. If equals 0, then ignore this.

fields.name: flying
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the monster is flagged as a flying type, which can affect its collision with the area level and how it is spawned. If equals 0, then ignore this.

fields.name: opendoors
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the monster will use its AI to open doors if necessary. If equals 0, then the monster cannot open doors and will treat doors as another type of collision.

fields.name: boss
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the monster is classified as a Boss type, which can affect boss related AI and functions. If equals 0, then ignore this.

fields.name: primeevil
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the monster is classified as a Prime Evil type, or an Act End boss, which can affect various skills, AI, and damage related functions. If equals 0, then ignore this.

fields.name: killable
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the monster can be killed, damage, and be put in a Death or Dead mode. If equals 0, then the monster cannot be damaged or killed.

fields.name: switchai
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then monster's AI can switched, such as by the Assassin's Mind Blast ability. If equals 0, then the monster AI cannot be switched.

fields.name: noAura
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the monster cannot be affected by friendly auras. If equals 0, then the monster can be affected by friendly auras.

fields.name: nomultishot
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the monster is not allowed to spawn with the Multi-Shot unique monster modifier (See monumod.txt). If equals 0, then ignore this.

fields.name: nopreventmonsterheal
fields.description: Boolean Field. Prevents the "item_preventheal" stat from working on this monster.

fields.name: neverCount
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the monster is not counted on the list of the active monsters in the area, which affects spawning and saving functions. If equals 0, then the monster will be accounted for, and can be part of the active or inactive list functions.

fields.name: petIgnore
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then pet AI scripts will ignore this monster (See monai.txt). If equals 0, then pet AI will attack this monster.

fields.name: deathDmg
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the monster will explode on death. This has special cases for the "bonefetish1" and "siegebeast1" monster classes, otherwise the monster will use a general death damage function to damage nearby units based on the monster's health percentage. If equals 0, then ignore this.

fields.name: genericSpawn
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, the monster is flagged as a possible selection for the AI generic spawner function. There are defaults for using the If equals 0, then ignore this.

fields.name: zoo
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the monster will be flagged as a zoo type monster, which will give it the AI zoo behavior. If equals 0, then ignore this.

fields.name: CannotDesecrate
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the monster will not be able to be desecrated when inside a desecrated level. If equals 0, then ignore this.

fields.name: CannotHerald
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the monster will not be able to be a base monster for a Herald. If equals 0, then ignore this.

fields.name: rightArmItemType
fields.description: Determines what type of items the monster is allowed to hold in the corresponding arm (see itemtypes.txt). A blank value means it can hold any item.

fields.name: canNotUseTwoHandedItems
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the monster can not items marked as two handed (see weapons.txt)

fields.name: SendSkills
fields.description: Determines which of the monster's skill's level should be sent to the client. Uses a byte value, where the code tests each bit to determine which of the monster's skills to check.

fields.name: Skill#
fields.description: Points to a skill. This gives the monster the skill to use (requires Sk#mode)

fields.name: Sk#mode
fields.description: Determines the monster's animation mode when using the related skill. Outside of the standard animation mode inputs from code (MonMode), the field can also point to a sequence (monseq), which handle a specific set of frames to place a sequence animation.
fields.format: References a code (MonMode) or a sequence (monseq)

fields.name: Sk#lvl
fields.description: Controls the base skill level of the related skill on the monster

fields.name: Drain
fields.description: Controls the monster's overall Life and Mana steal percentage. This can also be affected by the LifeStealDivisor (difficultylevels) and ManaStealDivisor (difficultylevels) fields from the difficultylevels.txt file. If equals 0, then the monster will not have Life or Mana steal.

fields.name: coldeffect
fields.description: Sets the percentage change in movement speed and attack rate when the monster if chilled by a cold effect. If this equals 0, then the monster will be immune to the cold effect.

fields.name: ResDm
fields.description: Sets the monster's Physical Damage Resistance stat

fields.name: ResMa
fields.description: Sets the monster's Magic Resistance stat

fields.name: ResFi
fields.description: Sets the monster's Fire Resistance stat

fields.name: ResLi
fields.description: Sets the monster's Lightning Resistance stat

fields.name: ResCo
fields.description: Sets the monster's Cold Resistance stat

fields.name: ResPo
fields.description: Sets the monster's Poison Resistance stat

fields.name: DamageRegen
fields.description: Controls the monster's Life regeneration per frame. This is calculated based on the monster's maximum life: Regeneration Rate = (Life * DamageRegen) / 16

fields.name: SkillDamage
fields.description: This changes the monster's min physical damage, max physical damage, and Attack Rating to be based off the values from the linked skill and its current level from the monster's owner (usually the player who summoned the monster).

fields.name: noRatio
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then use this file's fields to determine the monster's baseline stats (minHP, maxHP, AC, Exp, A1MinD, A1MaxD, A1TH, A2MinD, A2MaxD, A2TH, S1MinD, S1MaxD, S1TH). If equals 0, then use the monlvl.txt file to determine the monster's baseline stats.

fields.name: ShieldBlockOverride
fields.description: If equals 1, then the monster can block without a shield (the block chance stat will take effect even without a shield equipped). If equals 2, then the monster cannot block at all, even with a shield equipped. If equals 0, then ignore this.

fields.name: ToBlock
fields.description: The monster's percent chance to block an attack

fields.name: Crit
fields.description: The percent chance for the monster to score a critical hit when attacking an enemy, which causes the attack to deal double damage

fields.name: minHP
fields.description: The monster's minimum amount of Life when spawned

fields.name: maxHP
fields.description: The monster's maximum amount of Life when spawned

fields.name: AC
fields.description: The monster's Defense value

fields.name: Exp
fields.description: The amount of Experience that is rewarded to the player when the monster is killed

fields.name: A1MinD
fields.description: The minimum damage dealt by the monster when it is using the Attack 1 (A1) animation mode

fields.name: A1MaxD
fields.description: The maximum damage dealt by the monster when it is using the Attack 1 (A1) animation mode

fields.name: A1TH
fields.description: The monster's Attack Rating when it is using the Attack 1 (A1) animation mode

fields.name: A2MinD
fields.description: The minimum damage dealt by the monster when it is using the Attack 2 (A2) animation mode

fields.name: A2MaxD
fields.description: The maximum damage dealt by the monster when it is using the Attack 2 (A2) animation mode

fields.name: A2TH
fields.description: The monster's Attack Rating when it is using the Attack 2 (A2) animation mode

fields.name: S1MinD
fields.description: The minimum damage dealt by the monster when it is using the Skill 1 (S1) animation mode

fields.name: S1MaxD
fields.description: The maximum damage dealt by the monster when it is using the Skill 1 (S1) animation mode

fields.name: S1TH
fields.description: The monster's Attack Rating when it is using the Skill 1 (S1) animation mode

fields.name: El#Mode
fields.description: Determines which animation mode will trigger an additional elemental damage type when used

fields.name: El#Type
fields.description: Defines the type of elemental damage. This field is used when El#Mode is not null.

fields.name: El#Pct
fields.description: Controls the random percent chance (out of 100) that the monster will append the element damage to the attack. This field is used when El#Mode is not null.

fields.name: El#MinD
fields.description: The minimum element damage applied to the attack. This field is used when El#Mode is not null.

fields.name: El#MaxD
fields.description: The maximum element damage applied to the attack. This field is used when El#Mode is not null.

fields.name: El#Dur
fields.description: Controls the duration of the related element mode in frame lengths (25 Frames = 1 Second). This is only applicable for the Cold, Poison, Stun, Burning, Freeze elements. There are special cases when evaluating the elements, where Poison min and max damage are multiplied by 10, and Poison duration is multiplied by 2. This field is used when El#Mode is not null.

fields.name: TreasureClass
fields.description: Defines which Treasure Class is used by the monster when it is killed. Used for normal monster types.

fields.name: TreasureClassChamp
fields.description: Defines which Treasure Class is used by the monster when it is killed. Used for Champion monster types.

fields.name: TreasureClassUnique
fields.description: Defines which Treasure Class is used by the monster when it is killed. Used for Unique monster types.

fields.name: TreasureClassQuest
fields.description: Defines which Treasure Class is used by the monster when it is killed. Used for quest related monster drops (See TCQuestId and TCQuestCP).

fields.name: TreasureClassDesecrated
fields.description: Defines which Treasure Class is used by the monster when it is killed while desecrated (Terrorized). Used for normal monster types.

fields.name: TreasureClassDesecratedChamp
fields.description: Defines which Treasure Class is used by the monster when it is killed while desecrated (Terrorized). Used for Champion monster types.

fields.name: TreasureClassDesecratedUnique
fields.description: Defines which Treasure Class is used by the monster when it is killed while desecrated (Terrorized). Used for Unique monster types.

fields.name: TreasureClassHerald
fields.description: Defines which Treasure Class is used by the monster when it is killed. Used for Herald monster types.

fields.name: TCQuestId
fields.description: Checks to see if the player has does not have a quest flag progress. If not, then use the TreasureClassQuest field, based on the game's current difficulty.

fields.name: TCQuestCP
fields.description: Controls which Quest Checkpoint, or current progress within a quest (based on the TCQuestId value), is needed to use the TreasureClassQuest field, based on the game's current difficulty

fields.name: SplEndDeath
fields.description: Controls a special case death handler for the monster that is ran on the server side
table: Spawn the monster type from the minion1 field after this monster dies
Kill the source unit that is related to this monster. Typically this is a mount type unit that the monster is riding when it dies
Remove the unit from the game.

fields.name: SplGetModeChart
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then check special case handlers of certain monsters with specific BaseId fields while they are using certain a mode and perform a function. If equals 0, then ignore this.
table: If current mode equals Skill 3 (S3) or Skill 4 (S4), then do a generic attack function

If current mode equals Attack 1 (A1), Attack 2 (A2), Skill 1 (S1), or Skill 2 (S2), then do a generic attack function and end it with setting the monster to start the Skill 1 mode and skip the AI pause
If the current mode equals Skill 3 (S3), then tell the monster to do its Cast mode (SC)
If the current mode equals Skill 3 (S3), then tell the monster to do its Cast mode (SC)
If the current mode equals Skill 4 (S4), then tell the monster to do a generic attack function

fields.name: SplEndGeneric
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then check special case handlers of monsters with specific BaseId fields while they are ending certain modes and perform a function. If equals 0, then ignore this.

fields.name: SplClientEnd
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then on the client side, check special case handlers of monsters with specific BaseId fields while they are ending certain modes and perform a function. If equals 0, then ignore this.
table: Ignore setting the monster back to Neutral (NU)

Skill 1 (S1)
or Skill 2 (S2)
or Attack 1 (A1)
or Attack 2 (A2)
Ignore setting the monster back to Neutral (NU)
Ignore setting the monster back to Neutral (NU)
Remove the siege missile and add a new one
Ignore setting the monster back to Neutral (NU)
Ignore setting the monster back to Neutral (NU)

monstats2.title: monstats2.txt
monstats2.overview:
This file controls additional functionalities and statistics for every monster in the game.
Any column field name starting with "*" is considered a comment field and is not used by the game.

fields.name: Id
fields.description: Controls the unique name ID to define the monstats2 entry.

fields.name: Height
fields.description: Determines the height of the monster. This has 2 purposes. The first purpose is to act as an index value for selecting which icebreak missile to use when the monster dies while frozen. The second purpose is to select a code which affects what attack animation the player characters will use when attacking the monster (Attack1 and or Attack2). See each code description types below.

fields.name: OverlayHeight
fields.description: Determines the height value of overlays (See overlay.txt) for the monster

fields.name: pixHeight
fields.description: Determines the pixel height value for the damage bar when the monster is selected

fields.name: SizeX
fields.description: Determines the tile grid size of the monster which is use for handling placement when the monster spawns or uses movement skills

fields.name: spawnCol
fields.description: Controls the method for spawning the monster based on the collisions in the environment
table: Water - Handle water terrain where units cannot normally walk, but can fly over
Preset - Placement handler which considers walls, no pathable areas, objects, doors, items, and other monsters

fields.name: MeleeRng
fields.description: Controls the range of the monster's melee attack, which can affect also affect certain AI pathing. If this value equals 255, then refer to the monster's weapon class (BaseW).

fields.name: BaseW
fields.description: Defines the monster's base weapon class, which can affect how the monster attacks. Uses a EWEAPONCLASS (enums)

fields.name: HitClass
fields.description: Defines the specific class of an attack when the monster successfully hits with an attack. This can affect the sound and overlay display of the attack hit. Uses an integer index.

fields.name: COMPv
fields.description: Formula fields that define the types of visual graphics to use for the specific component field. Users can add input parameters by adding a comma "," to the input and using a code.
fields.format: Comma "," separated inputs. For a list of possible component inputs, see the compcode.txt file.

fields.name: COMP
fields.description: Boolean fields, which control which specific component piece is enabled for the monster. If equals 1, then the component is enabled. If equals 0, then the monster does not have that component. Corresponds to the matching COMPv

fields.name: TotalPieces
fields.description: Defines the total amount of component pieces that the monster uses. This value should match the number of enabled Boolean fields listed in COMP.

fields.name: mDT
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then enable the Death Mode for the monster. If equals 0, then this mode is disabled.

fields.name: mNU
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then enable the Neutral Mode for the monster. If equals 0, then this mode is disabled.

fields.name: mWL
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then enable the Walk Mode for the monster. If equals 0, then this mode is disabled.

fields.name: mGH
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then enable the Get Hit Mode for the monster. If equals 0, then this mode is disabled.

fields.name: mA1
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then enable the Attack 1 Mode for the monster. If equals 0, then this mode is disabled.

fields.name: mA2
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then enable the Attack 2 Mode for the monster. If equals 0, then this mode is disabled.

fields.name: mBL
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then enable the Block Mode for the monster. If equals 0, then this mode is disabled.

fields.name: mSC
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then enable the Cast Mode for the monster. If equals 0, then this mode is disabled.

fields.name: mS#
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then enable the corresponding Skill Mode for the monster. If equals 0, then this mode is disabled.

fields.name: mDD
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then enable the Dead Mode for the monster. If equals 0, then this mode is disabled.

fields.name: mKB
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then enable the Knockback Mode for the monster. If equals 0, then this mode is disabled.

fields.name: mSQ
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then enable the Sequence Mode for the monster. If equals 0, then this mode is disabled.

fields.name: mRN
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then enable the Run Mode for the monster. If equals 0, then this mode is disabled.

fields.name: dDT
fields.description: Defines the number of directions that the monster can face during Death Mode

fields.name: dNU
fields.description: Defines the number of directions that the monster can face during Neutral Mode

fields.name: dWL
fields.description: Defines the number of directions that the monster can face during Walk Mode

fields.name: dGH
fields.description: Defines the number of directions that the monster can face during Get Hit Mode

fields.name: dA1
fields.description: Defines the number of directions that the monster can face during Attack 1 Mode

fields.name: dA2
fields.description: Defines the number of directions that the monster can face during Attack 2 Mode

fields.name: dBL
fields.description: Defines the number of directions that the monster can face during Block Mode

fields.name: dSC
fields.description: Defines the number of directions that the monster can face during Cast Mode

fields.name: dS#
fields.description: Defines the number of directions that the monster can face during the corresponding Skill Mode

fields.name: dDD
fields.description: Defines the number of directions that the monster can face during Dead Mode

fields.name: dKB
fields.description: Defines the number of directions that the monster can face during Knockback Mode

fields.name: dSQ
fields.description: Defines the number of directions that the monster can face during Sequence Mode

fields.name: dRN
fields.description: Defines the number of directions that the monster can face during Run Mode

fields.name: A1mv
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then enable the Attack 1 Mode while the monster is moving with the Walk mode or Run mode. If equals 0, then this mode is disabled while the monster is moving.

fields.name: A2mv
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then enable the Attack 2 Mode while the monster is moving with the Walk mode or Run mode. If equals 0, then this mode is disabled while the monster is moving.

fields.name: SCmv
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then enable the Cast Mode while the monster is moving with the Walk mode or Run mode. If equals 0, then this mode is disabled while the monster is moving.

fields.name: S#mv
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then enable the corresponding Skill Mode while the monster is moving with the Walk mode or Run mode. If equals 0, then this mode is disabled while the monster is moving.

fields.name: noGfxHitTest
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then enable the mouse selection bounding box functionality around the monster. If equals 0, then the monster cannot be selected by the mouse.

fields.name: htTop
fields.description: Define the pixel top offset around the monster for the mouse selection bounding box functionality. This field relies on the noGfxHitTest field being enabled.

fields.name: htLeft
fields.description: Define the pixel left offset around the monster for the mouse selection bounding box functionality. This field relies on the noGfxHitTest field being enabled.

fields.name: htWidth
fields.description: Define the pixel right offset around the monster for the mouse selection bounding box functionality. This field relies on the noGfxHitTest field being enabled.

fields.name: htHeight
fields.description: Define the pixel bottom offset around the monster for the mouse selection bounding box functionality. This field relies on the noGfxHitTest field being enabled.

fields.name: restore
fields.description: Determines if the monster should be placed on the inactive list, to be saved when the level unloads. If equals 0, then do not save the monster. If equals 1, then rely on other checks to determine to save the monster. If equals 2, then force save the monster.

fields.name: automapCel
fields.description: Controls what index of the Automap tiles to use to display this monster on the Automap. This field relies on the noMap field being disabled.

fields.name: noMap
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the monster will not appear on the Automap. If equals 0, then the monster will normally appear on the Automap.

fields.name: noOvly
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then no looping overlays will be drawn on the monster. If equals 0, then overlays will be drawn on the monster. (See overlay.txt)

fields.name: isSel
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the monster is selectable and can be targeted. If equals 0, then the monster cannot be selected.

fields.name: alSel
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the player can always select the monster, regardless of being an ally or enemy. If equals 0, then ignore this.

fields.name: noSel
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the player can never select the monster. If equals 0, then ignore this.

fields.name: shiftSel
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the player can target this monster when holding the Shift key and clicking to use a skill. If equals 0, then the monster cannot be targeted while the player is holding the Shift key.

fields.name: corpseSel
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the monster's corpse can be with the mouse cursor. If equals 0, then the monster's corpse cannot be selected with the mouse cursor.

fields.name: isAtt
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the monster can be attacked. If equals 0, then the monster cannot be attacked.

fields.name: revive
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the monster is allowed to be revived by the Necromancer Revive skill. If equals 0, then the monster cannot be revived by the Necromancer Revive skill.

fields.name: limitCorpses
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the monster's corpse will be placed into a pool with all other corpses with this field checked. Once that pool reaches the max (50), the corpses at the beginning of the pool start getting removed.

fields.name: critter
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the monster will be flagged as a critter, which gives some special case handling such as not creating impact sounds and differently handling its spawn placement in presets. If equals 0, then ignore this.

fields.name: small
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the monster will be classified as a small type, which can affect what types of missiles can be used on the monster (Example: Barbarian Grim Ward size) or how the monster is knocked back. If equals 0, then ignore this. If this field is enabled, then the large field should be disabled, to avoid confusion.

fields.name: large
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the monster will be classified as a large type, which can affect what types of missiles can be used on the monster (Example: Barbarian Grim Ward size) or how the monster is knocked back. If equals 0, then ignore this. If this field is enabled, then the small field should be disabled, to avoid confusion.

fields.name: soft
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the monster's corpse is classified as soft bodied, meaning that its corpse can be used by certain corpse skills such as Barbarian Find Potion, Find Item, or Grim Ward. If equals 0, then the monster's corpse cannot be used for these skills.

fields.name: inert
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the monster will never attack its enemies. If equals 0, then ignore this.

fields.name: objCol
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1 and the monster class is "barricadedoor", "barricadedoor2", or "evilhut", then the monster will place an invisible object with collision. If equals 0, then ignore this.

fields.name: deadCol
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the monster's corpse will have collision with other units. If equals 0, then the monster's corpse will not have collision.

fields.name: unflatDead
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then ignore the corpse draw order for rendering the sprite on top of others, while the monster is dead. If equals 0, then the monster's corpse will have a normal corpse draw order.

fields.name: Shadow
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the monster will project a shadow on the ground. If equals 0, then the monster will not project a shadow.

fields.name: noUniqueShift
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1 and the monster is a Unique monster, then the monster will not have random color palette transform shifts.  If equals 0, then the non-Unique monster will have random color palette transform shifts.

fields.name: compositeDeath
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the monster's Death Mode and Dead mode will make use of its component system. If equals 0, then the monster will default to using the Hand-To-Hand weapon class and no component system.

fields.name: localBlood
fields.description: Controls the color of the monster's blood based on the region locale. If equals 0, then do not change the blood to green and keep it red. If equals 1, then change the monster's special components to use the green blood locale. If equals 2, then change the blood to green.

fields.name: Bleed
fields.description: Controls if the monster will create blood missiles. If equals 0, then the monster will never bleed. If equals 1, then the monster will randomly create the "blood1" or "blood2" missiles when hit. If equals 2, then the monster will randomly create the "blood1", "blood2", "bigblood1", or "bigblood2" missiles when hit.

fields.name: Light
fields.description: Controls the monster's minimum Light Radius size (measured in grid sub-tiles)

fields.name: light-r
fields.description: Controls the red color value of the monster's Light Radius (Uses a value from 0 to 255)

fields.name: light-g
fields.description: Controls the green color value of the monster's Light Radius (Uses a value from 0 to 255)

fields.name: light-b
fields.description: Controls the blue color value of the monster's Light Radius (Uses a value from 0 to 255)

fields.name: Utrans
fields.description: Modifies the color palette transform for the monster respectively in Normal, Nightmare, and Hell difficulty.

fields.name: InfernoLen
fields.description: The frame length to hold the channel cast time of the inferno skill. This is used for when the monster has the "inferno" state, or for Diablo when he is using the "DiabLight" skill.

fields.name: InfernoAnim
fields.description: The exact frame in the channel animation to loop back and start at again

fields.name: InfernoRollback
fields.description: The exact frame in the channel animation to determine when to roll back to the InfernoAnim frame

fields.name: ResurrectMode
fields.description: Controls which monster mode to set on the monster when it is resurrected. Uses a code (MonMode)

fields.name: ResurrectSkill
fields.description: Controls what skill should the monster use when it is resurrected.

fields.name: SpawnUniqueMod
fields.description: Controls what unique modifier the monster should always spawn with.

montype.title: MonType.txt
montype.overview:
This file handles the classification, naming conventions and element of monsters.
Any column field name starting with "*" is considered a comment field and is not used by the game.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Defines the unique monster type ID

fields.name: equiv#
fields.description: Points to the index of another Monster Type to reference as a parent. This is used to create a hierarchy for Monster Types where the parents will have more universal settings shared across the related children

fields.name: strplur
fields.description: Uses a string for the plural form of the monster type. This is used for the descfunc (itemstatcost) code 22 function, based on the monster type selected.

fields.name: element
fields.description: Defines the monster's element type. This can be used for the Necromancer's Raise Skeletal Mage skill for determining what elemental type a Skeletal Mage should be based on the monster it was raised from (If the monster has no element, then the skeletal mage element will be randomly selected).

monumod.title: monumod.txt
monumod.overview:
This file controls the different monster modifiers for special monsters, including Unique and Champion monsters.
The "(N)" text in field names signifies to use that specific value for games in Nightmare difficulty. The "(H)" text in field names signifies to use that specific value for games in Hell difficulty.
Any column field name starting with "*" is considered a comment field and is not used by the game.

fields.name: uniquemod
fields.description: This is a reference field to define the monster modifier

fields.name: enabled
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then this monster modifier will be an available option for monsters to spawn with. If equals 0, then this monster modifier will never be used.

fields.name: version
fields.description: Defines which game version to use this monster modifier (<100 = Classic mode | 100 = Expansion mode)

fields.name: xfer
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then this monster modifier can be transferred from the Boss monster to his Minion monsters, including auras. If equals 0, then the monster modifier will never be transferred.

fields.name: champion
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then this monster modifier will only be used by Champion monsters. If equals 0, then the monster modifier can be used by any type of special monster.

fields.name: fPick
fields.description: Controls if this monster modifier is allowed on the monster based on the function code and the parameters it checks.
table: Monster class must have the Attack 1 mode (checks the mA1 (monstats2) field)

Monster class cannot be flagged as Melee (checks the isMelee (monstats) field)
Monster class cannot have the No Multishot flag (checks the nomultishot (monstats) field)
Monster class must have the Walk mode (checks mWL (monstats2) field)

fields.name: exclude#
fields.description: This controls which Monster Types should not have this monster modifier (Uses the type (montype) field)

fields.name: cpick
fields.description: Modifies the chances that this monster modifier will be chosen for a Champion monster, compared to other monster modifiers. The higher the value is, then the more likely this modifier will be chosen. This value acts as a numerator and a denominator. All cpick values get summed together to give a total denominator, used for the random roll. For example, if there are 3 possible monster modifiers, and their cpick values are 3, 4, 6, then their chances to be chosen are 3/13, 4/13, and 6/13 respectively.

fields.name: upick
fields.description: Modifies the chances that this monster modifier will be chosen for a Unique monster, compared to other monster modifiers. The higher the value is, then the more likely this modifier will be chosen. This value acts as a numerator and a denominator. All upick values get summed together to give a total denominator, used for the random roll. For example, if there are 3 possible monster modifiers, and their upick values are 3, 4, 6, then their chances to be chosen are 3/13, 4/13, and 6/13 respectively.

fields.name: constants
fields.description: These values control a special list of numeric parameters for special monsters. The row that each constant appears in the data file is unrelated. You can treat this column almost like a separate data file that controls other aspects of special monsters. See the description next to each value for more specific clarification on each constant.

npc.title: npc.txt
npc.overview:
This file controls how each town NPC manipulates their store prices.
Any column field name starting with "*" is considered a comment field and is not used by the game.

fields.name: npc
fields.description: Points to the matching Id (monstats) value. This should not be changed.

fields.name: buy mult
fields.description: Used to calculate the item's price when it is bought by the NPC from the player. This number is a fraction of 1024 in the following formula: [cost] * [buy mult] / 1024

fields.name: sell mult
fields.description: Used to calculate the item's price when it is sold by the NPC to the player. This number is a fraction of 1024 in the following formula: [cost] * [sell mult] / 1024

fields.name: rep mult
fields.description: Used to calculate the cost to repair an item. This number is a fraction of 1024 in the following formula: [cost] * [rep mult] / 1024. This is then used to influence the repair cost based on the item durability and charges.

fields.name: questflag
fields.description: If the player has this quest flag progress, then apply the relative additional price calculations

fields.name: questbuymult
fields.description: Same functionality as the buy mult field, except this relies on the questflag field and applies after the buy mult field calculation

fields.name: questsellmult
fields.description: Same functionality as the sell mult field, except this relies on the questflag field and applies after the sell mult field calculation

fields.name: questrepmult
fields.description: Same functionality as the rep mult field, except this relies on the questflag field and applies after the rep mult field calculation

fields.name: max buy
fields.description: Sets the maximum price that the NPC will pay, when the player sells an item in Normal Difficulty, Nightmare Difficulty, and Hell Difficulty, respectively

objects.title: objects.txt
objects.overview:
This file controls the functionalities of all objects found in area levels. The order of each object defined in this file will convey what ID value it has, and thus should not be changed.
Any column field name starting with "*" is considered a comment field and is not used by the game.

fields.name: Class
fields.description: Defines the unique type class of the object which is used to reference this object.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: String key. Used as the display name of the object when being highlighted by the player.

fields.name: Token
fields.description: Determines what files to use to display the graphics of the object.

fields.name: Selectable#
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the object can be selected by the player and highlighted when hovered on by the mouse cursor. If equals 0, then the object cannot be selected and will not highlight when the player hovers the mouse over it. Each field is numbered, correlating to 1 of 8 Object Modes that the object uses (See Token (ObjMode)).

fields.name: SizeX
