fields.name: missile
fields.description: Used as a possible parameter for the setfunc field

fields.name: skill
fields.description: Used as a possible parameter for the setfunc field

fields.name: itemtype
fields.description: Defines a potential Item Type that can be affected by the state's color change

fields.name: itemtrans
fields.description: Controls the color change of the item when the unit has this state

fields.name: colorpri
fields.description: Defines the priority of the state's color change, when compared to other current sates on the unit. The current state that has the highest color priority on the unit will be used and other state colors will be ignored. If multiple current states share the same color priority value, then the game will choose the state with the lower ID value (based on where in the list of states in the data file that the state is defined)

fields.name: colorshift
fields.description: Controls which index of the color shift palette to use.
table:
Color to Green
(There is a special case to not turn the player unit green)

fields.name: light-r
fields.description: Controls the state's change of the red color value of the Light radius (Uses a value from 0 to 255)

fields.name: light-g
fields.description: Controls the state's change of the green color value of the Light radius (Uses a value from 0 to 255)

fields.name: light-b
fields.description: Controls the state's change of the blue color value of the Light radius (Uses a value from 0 to 255)

fields.name: onsound
fields.description: Plays a sound when the state is initially applied to the unit.

fields.name: offsound
fields.description: Plays a sound when the state is removed from the unit.

fields.name: gfxtype
fields.description: Controls the how to handle the unit graphics transformation based on the unit type (This relies on the disguise field being enabled). If equals 1, then use this on a monster type unit. If equals 2, then use this on a player type unit. Otherwise, ignore this.

fields.name: gfxclass
fields.description: Controls the unit class used for handling the unit graphics transformation. This field relies on what unit type was used in the gfxtype field. If gfxtype equals 1 for monster type units, then this field will rely on the index of an entry from monstats.txt. If gfxtype equals 2, then this field will use the index of an entry from PlayerClass.txt.

fields.name: cltevent
fields.description: Controls the event to check on the client side to determine when to use the function defined in the clteventfunc field

fields.name: clteventfunc
fields.description: Controls the client Unit event function that is called when the event is determined in the cltevent field. Corresponds to a Client Event Functions (enums).

fields.name: cltactivefunc
fields.description: Controls the Client Do function that is called every frame while the state is active (see the cltdofunc (skills) field). This relies on the active field being enabled.

fields.name: srvactivefunc
fields.description: Controls the Server Do function that is called every frame while the state is active (see the srvdofunc (skills) field). This relies on the active field being enabled.

fields.name: canstack
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then this state can stack with duplicate forms of itself (This is only usable with the "poison" state). If equals 0, then ignore this.

fields.name: sunderfull
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then this state will reapply any negative resistance stats at full potential when calculating pierce immunity if the immunity was broken. If equals 0, then reapply at the normal reduced efficiency (currently 1/5).

fields.name: sunder-res-reduce
fields.description: Boolean Field.  If equals 1, then this state will apply pierce resistance at reduced effectiveness (currently 1/5) when calculating pierce resistance if an immunity was broken. If equals 0, then apply pierce resistance at normal effectiveness.

fields.name: vfxweaponstate
fields.description: Specifies which weapon state to set on the vfx.

storepage.title: StorePage.txt
storepage.overview:
Reference file that defines npc store pages.
Any column field name starting with "*" is considered a comment field and is not used by the game.

fields.name: Code
fields.description: 4 letter code referencing the page

superuniques.title: SuperUniques.txt
superuniques.overview:
This file defines the Super Unique monsters and their properties. Super Unique monsters are considered the special boss monsters that have static encounters in the game.
Any column field name starting with "*" is considered a comment field and is not used by the game.

fields.name: Superunique
fields.description: Defines the unique name ID for the Super Unique monster

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Uses a string for the Super Unique monster's name

fields.name: Class
fields.description: Defines the baseline monster type for the Super Unique monster, which this monster will use for default values.

fields.name: hcIdx
fields.description: Defines the unique numeric ID for the Super Unique monster. The existing IDs are hardcoded for specific scripts with the specified Super Unique monsters.

fields.name: MonSound
fields.description: Defines what set of sounds to use for the Super Unique monster. If this field is empty, then the Super Unique monster will default to using the monster class sounds.

fields.name: Mod#
fields.description: Controls which monster modifier to assign to the Super Unique monster. Uses the index of an entry from monumod.txt (See that file for details on the available modifiers).

fields.name: MinGrp
fields.description: Controls the min amount of Minion monsters that will spawn with the Super Unique monster.

fields.name: MaxGrp
fields.description: Controls the max amount of Minion monsters that will spawn with the Super Unique monster. This value must be equal to or higher than MinGrp. If this value is greater than MinGrp then a random number will be chosen between the MinGrp and MaxGrp values.

fields.name: AutoPos
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the Super Unique monster will randomly spawn within a radius of its designated position. If equals 0, then the Super Unique monster will spawn at exact coordinates of its designated position.

fields.name: Stacks
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then this Super Unique monster can spawn more than once in the same game. If equals 0, then this Super Unique monster can only spawn once in the same game.

fields.name: Replaceable
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the room where the Super Unique monster spawns in can be replaced during the creation of a level preset. If equals 0, then the room cannot be replaced and will remain static.

fields.name: Utrans
fields.description: Modifies the color transform for the unique monster respectively in Normal, Nightmare, or Hell difficulty. If this value is greater than or equal to 30, then the value will default to 2, which is the monster's default color palette shift. If the value is 0 or is empty, then a random value will be chosen.

fields.name: TC
fields.description: Controls the Treasure Class to use when the Super Unique monster is killed respectively in Normal, Nightmare, or Hell difficulty.

fields.name: TC Desecrated
fields.description: Controls the Treasure Class to use when the Super Unique monster is desecrated (Terrorized) and killed respectively in Normal, Nightmare, or Hell difficulty.

treasureclassex.title: TreasureClassEx.txt
treasureclassex.overview:
This file controls the Treasure Class linked to a monster drop. Treasure Classes are groups of item types and their chances of dropping from a monster.
Any column field name starting with "*" is considered a comment field and is not used by the game.

fields.name: Treasure Class
fields.description: Defines the unique Treasure Class ID, that is referenced in other files.

fields.name: group
fields.description: Assigns the Treasure Class to a group ID value, which will connect this Treasure Class with other Treasure Classes, as a potential Treasure Class to use for an itemdrop. When determining which Treasure Class to use for an item drop, the game will iterate through all Treasure Classes that share the same group. This field works with the level field to determine an ideal Treasure Class to use for the monster drop. Treasure Classes that share the same group should be in contiguous order.

fields.name: level
fields.description: Defines the level of a Treasure Class. Monsters who have a Treasure Class will pick the Treasure Class that a level value that is less than or equal to the monster's level. This is ignored for Boss monsters unless that Boss monster is desecrated.

fields.name: Picks
fields.description: Controls how to handle the calculations for item drops. If this value is positive, then this value will control how many item drop chances will be rolled for the Treasure Class using the Prob# fields as probability values. If this value is negative, then this value functions as the total guaranteed quantity of item drops from the Treasure Class, and each Prob# field now defines the quantity of items generated from its related Item# field. If this field is empty, then default to a value of 1.

fields.name: Unique
fields.description: Modifies the item ratio drop for a Unique Quality item. A higher value means a better chance of being chosen. (See itemratio.txt for an explanation for how the Item Quality is chosen)

fields.name: Set
fields.description: Modifies the item ratio drop for a Set Quality item. A higher value means a better chance of being chosen. (See itemratio.txt for an explanation for how the Item Quality is chosen)

fields.name: Rare
fields.description: Modifies the item ratio drop for a Rare Quality item. A higher value means a better chance of being chosen. (See itemratio.txt for an explanation for how the Item Quality is chosen)

fields.name: Magic
fields.description: Modifies the item ratio drop for a Magic Quality item. A higher value means a better chance of being chosen. (See itemratio.txt for an explanation for how the Item Quality is chosen)

fields.name: NoDrop
fields.description: Controls the probability of no item dropping by the Treasure Class. The higher this value, then the more likely no item will drop from the monster. This can be automatically be affected by the number of players currently in the game.

fields.name: Item#
fields.description: Defines an entry in the treasure class. This can be a specific item code, another Treasure Class, a index (uniqueitems), or a index (setitems). Linking another Treasure Class in this field means that there is a chance to use that Treasure Class group of items which the game will then calculate a selection from that Treasure Class, and so on. Additional modifiers can also be defined, separated by a comma ",". The modifier must have an equal sign "=" then a value. For example "gld,mul=1280"
table: Modify the "spec mod". For example, this modifies the amount of gold dropped or the specific unique or set index of an item.
Modify chance to be a unique item.
Modify chance to be a set item.
Modify chance to be a rare item.
Modify chance to be a magic item.
Modify chance to be an ethereal item.
Modify chance to be a socketed item.
Modify the "spec mod". For example, this modifies the amount of gold dropped or the specific unique or set index of an item.
Modify the "spec mod". For example, this modifies the amount of gold dropped or the specific unique or set index of an item.

fields.name: Prob#
fields.description: The individual probability for each related Item# drop. The higher this value, then the more likely the Item# field will be chosen. The chance a drop is picked is calculated by summing all Prob# field values and the NoDrop value for a total denominator value, and then having each Prob# value and the NoDrop value rolling their chance out of the total denominator value for a drop.

fields.name: ConditionCalc
fields.description: If the evaluated result of this condition is 0, then prevent this treasure class from being rolled. If this is a sub-treasure class, its Prob# is completely removed from the roll.
fields.format: Treasure Class scope BBE. See BBE/Calc Fields

fields.name: firstLadderSeason
fields.description: Integer field. If this has a value, it will only roll in ladder games starting at the season specified (inclusive). If blank or 0 then it will roll in ladder and non-ladder.

fields.name: lastLadderSeason
fields.description: Integer field. The last ladder season the treasure class is ladder-only (inclusive). Must be used in conjunction with firstLadderSeason.

fields.name: noAlwaysSpawn
fields.description: Boolean field. If equals 1, then this treasure class will roll normally when being forced to always drop, like with the Find Item skill. If 0 then this treasure class will always drop an item when forced to.

fields.name: QuestFlag
fields.description: Controls what quest record that the player needs to have completed before this treasure class can be rolled, while playing in Classic Mode. Each quest can have multiple quest records, and this field is looking for a specific quest record from a quest. If this is a sub-treasure class, its Prob# is completely removed from the roll.

fields.name: QuestFlagEx
fields.description: Controls what quest record that the player needs to have completed before this treasure class can be rolled, while playing in Expansion Mode. Each quest can have multiple quest records, and this field is looking for a specific quest record from a quest. If this is a sub-treasure class, its Prob# is completely removed from the roll.

uniqueappellation.title: UniqueAppellation.txt
uniqueappellation.overview:
This file controls the list of strings that are randomly selected to be used as an extra suffix when generating unique monster names
The game has a 50% chance to randomly use Unique Appellation when generating the Unique monster name.
 · If a Unique Appellation is not added, then the game will generate a unique monster name using the string called Monster1Format (ID: 1721)
 · If a Unique Appellation is added, then the game will generate a unique monster name using the string called Monster2Format (ID: 1722)

fields.name: Name
fields.description: A string key, which is used as a potential selection for generating a unique monster's name

uniqueitems.title: UniqueItems.txt
uniqueitems.overview:
This file defines each Unique item and controls their item modifiers. The row order of items should not be changed because it defines their ID value.
Any column field name starting with "*" is considered a comment field and is not used by the game.

fields.name: index
fields.description: Points to a string key value to use as the Unique item's name

fields.name: version
fields.description: Defines which game version to create this item (<100 = Classic mode | 100 = Expansion mode)

fields.name: disabled
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, this unique is fully disabled and cannot be dropped randomly or explicitly from a treasure class.

fields.name: spawnable
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then this item can be rolled as a choice when randomly dropping a unique. If equals 0, then this item cannot be dropped randomly, but can still be drop explicitly from a treasure class.

fields.name: disableChronicle
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, this unique item will not appear in the chronicle.

fields.name: DropConditionCalc
fields.description: If the evaluated result of this condition is 0, then prevent the unique from being rolled as a choice when randomly dropping a unique.
fields.format: Treasure Class scope BBE. See BBE/Calc Fields

fields.name: firstLadderSeason
fields.description: Integer field. The first ladder season the unique item can be Dropped or created on (inclusive). If blank or 0 then it is available in non-ladder.

fields.name: lastLadderSeason
fields.description: Integer field. The last ladder season the unique item is ladder-only (inclusive). Must be used in conjunction with firstLadderSeason.

fields.name: rarity
fields.description: Modifies the chances that this Unique item will spawn compared to the other Unique items. This value acts as a numerator and a denominator. Each rarity value gets summed together to give a total denominator, used for the random roll for the item. For example, if there are 3 possible Unique items, and their rarity values are 3, 5, 7, then their chances to be chosen are 3/15, 5/15, and 7/15 respectively. (The minimum rarity value equals 1) (Only works for games in Expansion mode)

fields.name: nolimit
fields.description: Boolean Field. Requires the quest (misc) field to be enabled. If equals 1, then this item can be created and will automatically be identified. If equals 0, then ignore this.

fields.name: lvl
fields.description: The item level for the item, which controls what object or monster needs to be in order to drop this item

fields.name: lvl req
fields.description: The minimum character level required to equip the item

fields.name: code
fields.description: Defines the baseline item code to use for this Unique item (must match the code (armor), code (weapons), or code (misc) field)

fields.name: carry1
fields.description: Assigns the Unique item to a group. Players can only carry one item from each group in their inventory.

fields.name: cost mult
fields.description: Multiplicative modifier for the Unique item's buy, sell, and repair costs

fields.name: cost add
fields.description: Flat integer modification to the Unique item's buy, sell, and repair costs. This is added after the cost mult has modified the costs.

fields.name: chrtransform
fields.description: Controls the color change of the item when equipped on a character or dropped on the ground. If empty, then the item will have the default item color.

fields.name: invtransform
fields.description: Controls the color change of the item in the inventory UI. If empty, then the item will have the default item color.

fields.name: flippyfile
fields.description: An override for the flippyfile (armor), flippyfile (weapons), or flippyfile (misc) field. By default, the Unique item will use what was defined by the baseline item from the code field.

fields.name: invfile
fields.description: An override for the invfile (armor), invfile (weapons), or invfile (misc) field. By default, the Unique item will use what was defined by the baseline item from the code field.

fields.name: dropsound
fields.description: An override for the dropsound (armor), dropsound (weapons), or dropsound (misc) field. By default, the Unique item will use what was defined by the baseline item from the code field.

fields.name: dropsfxframe
fields.description: An override for the dropsfxframe (armor), dropsfxframe (weapons), or dropsfxframe (misc) field. By default, the Unique item will use what was defined by the baseline item from the code field.

fields.name: usesound
fields.description: An override for the usesound (armor), usesound (weapons), or usesound (misc) field. By default, the Unique item will use what was defined by the baseline item from the code field.

fields.name: prop#
fields.description: Controls the item properties for the Unique item
fields.format: References a code (properties) or a code (PropertyGroups)

fields.name: par#
fields.description: The stat's "parameter" value associated with the related property (prop#). Usage depends on the property function (See the func# (properties) field)
fields.format: A number or references skill (skills), type (montype), or state (states)

fields.name: min#
fields.description: The stat's "min" value to assign to the related property (prop#). Usage depends on the property function (See the func# (properties) field)

fields.name: max#
fields.description: The stat's "max" value to assign to the related property (prop#). Usage depends on the property function (See the func# (properties) field)

fields.name: diablocloneweight
fields.description: The amount of weight added to the diablo clone progress when this item is sold. When offline, selling this item will instead immediately spawn diablo clone.

uniqueprefix.title: UniquePrefix.txt
uniqueprefix.overview:
This file controls the list of strings that are randomly selected to be used as the prefix when generating unique monster names. This is always added to every unique monster name.
Any column field name starting with "*" is considered a comment field and is not used by the game.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: A string key, which is used as a potential selection for generating a unique monster's name

uniquesuffix.title: UniqueSuffix.txt
uniquesuffix.overview:
This file controls the list of strings that are randomly selected to be used as the suffix when generating unique monster names. This is always added to every unique monster name.
Any column field name starting with "*" is considered a comment field and is not used by the game.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: A string key, which is used as a potential selection for generating a unique monster's name

wanderingmon.title: wanderingmon.txt
wanderingmon.overview:
This file controls the list of monsters that can be used as good NPC units to randomly place in certain area levels. The actinfo.txt file controls the statistics on when to spawn wandering monsters, and this file simply controls the list of possible monsters to choose from.
Any column field name starting with "*" is considered a comment field and is not used by the game.

fields.name: class
fields.description: Monsters defined here are added to a list which is used to randomly pick a monster to spawn in an area level.

weapons.title: weapons.txt
weapons.overview:
This file controls the functionalities for weapons type items. This file is loaded together with other similar files in the following order: weapons.txt, armor.txt, misc.txt. These combined files form the items structure. Technically these files share the same fields, but some fields are exclusive for specific item types, so they are not displayed in the data files that do not need them. These are the fields exclusive to this file.
Any column field name starting with "*" is considered a comment field and is not used by the game.

fields.name: 1or2handed
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the item will be treated as a one-handed and two-handed weapon by the Barbarian class. If equals 0, then the Barbarian can only use this weapon as either one-handed or two-handed, but not both.

fields.name: 2handed
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the item will be treated as two-handed weapon. If equals 0, then the item will be treated as one-handed weapon.

fields.name: 2handmindam
fields.description: The minimum physical damage provided by the weapon if the item is two-handed. This relies on the 2handed field being enabled.

fields.name: 2handmaxdam
fields.description: The maximum physical damage provided by the weapon if the item is two-handed. This relies on the 2handed field being enabled.

fields.name: 2handedwclass
fields.description: Defines the two-handed weapon class, which controls what character animations are used when the weapon is equipped

fields.name: hit class
fields.description: Defines the hit class of the weapon which is used to know what SFX to use when the weapon hits an enemy

fields.name: minmisdam
fields.description: The maximum physical damage provided by the item if it is a throwing weapon

fields.name: maxmisdam
fields.description: The maximum physical damage provided by the item if it is a throwing weapon

fields.name: rangeadder
fields.description: Adds extra range in grid spaces for melee attacks while the melee weapon is equipped. The baseline melee range is 1, and this field adds to that range.

fields.name: wclass
fields.description: Defines the one-handed weapon class, which controls what character animations are used when the weapon is equipped

fields.name: version
fields.description: Defines which game version to create this item (0 = Classic mode | 100 = Expansion mode).

fields.name: compactsave
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then only the item's base stats will be stored in the character save, but not any modifiers or additional stats. If equals 0, then all of the items stats will be saved.

fields.name: rarity
fields.description: Determines the chance that the item will randomly spawn (1/#). The higher the value then the rarer the item will be. This field depends on the spawnable field being enabled, the quest field being disabled, and the item level being less than or equal to the area level. This value is also affected by the relative Act number that the item is dropping in, where the higher the Act number, then the more common the item will drop.

fields.name: spawnable
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then this item can be randomly spawned. If equals 0, then this item will never randomly spawn.

fields.name: DropConditionCalc
fields.description: If the evaluated result of this condition is 0, then prevent the item from being randomly dropped in treasure classes.
fields.format: Treasure Class scope BBE. See BBE/Calc Fields

fields.name: speed
fields.description: If the item type is an armor, then this will affect the Walk/Run Speed reduction when wearing the armor. If the item type is a weapon, then this will affect the Attack Speed reduction when wearing the weapon.

fields.name: reqstr
fields.description: Defines the amount of the Strength attribute needed to use the item.

fields.name: reqdex
fields.description: Defines the amount of the Dexterity attribute needed to use the item.

fields.name: durability
fields.description: Defines the base durability amount that the item will spawn with.

fields.name: nodurability
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the item will not have durability. If equals 0, then the item will have durability.

fields.name: level
fields.description: Controls the base item level. This is used for determining when the item is allowed to drop, such as making sure that the item level is not greater than the monster's level or the area level.

fields.name: ShowLevel
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then display the item level next to the item name. If equals 0, then ignore this.

fields.name: levelreq
fields.description: Controls the player level requirement for being able to use the item.

fields.name: cost
fields.description: Defines the base gold cost of the item when being sold by an NPC. This can be affected by item modifiers and the rarity of the item.

fields.name: gamble cost
fields.description: Defines the gambling gold cost of the item on the Gambling UI.

fields.name: code
fields.description: Defines a unique 3 letter/number code for the item. This is used as an identifier to reference the item.

fields.name: namestr
fields.description: String Key that is used for the base item name.

fields.name: magic lvl
fields.description: Defines the magic level of the item, which can affect how magical item modifiers that can appear on the item (See automagic.txt).

fields.name: auto prefix
fields.description: Automatically picks an item affix name from a designated group (automagic) value, instead of using random prefixes. This is only used when the item is Magical quality.

fields.name: alternategfx
fields.description: Uses a unique 3 letter/number code similar to the defined code fields to determine what in-game graphics to display on the player character when the item is equipped.

fields.name: normcode
fields.description: Links to a code field to determine the normal version of the item

fields.name: ubercode
fields.description: Links to a code field to determine the Exceptional version of the item

fields.name: ultracode
fields.description: Links to a code field to determine the Elite version of the item

fields.name: component
fields.description: Determines the layer of player animation when the item is equipped. This uses a code referenced from the Composit.txt file.

fields.name: invwidth
fields.description: Defines the width of grid cells that the item occupies in the player inventory.

fields.name: invheight
fields.description: Defines the height of grid cells that the item occupies in the player inventory.

fields.name: hasinv
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the item will have its own inventory allowing for the capability to socket gems, runes, or jewels. If equals 0, then the item cannot have sockets.

fields.name: gemsockets
fields.description: Controls the maximum number of sockets allowed on this item. This is limited by the item's size based on the invwidth and invheight fields. This also compares with MaxSockets# (itemtypes).

fields.name: gemapplytype
fields.description: Determines which affect from a gem or rune will be applied when it is socketed into this item (See gems.txt).

fields.name: flippyfile
fields.description: Controls which DC6 file to use for displaying the item in the game world when it is dropped on the ground (uses the file name as the input).

fields.name: invfile
fields.description: Controls which DC6 file to use for displaying the item graphics in the inventory (uses the file name as the input).

fields.name: uniqueinvfile
fields.description: Controls which DC6 file to use for displaying the item graphics in the inventory when it is a Unique quality item (uses the file name as the input).

fields.name: setinvfile
fields.description: Controls which DC6 file to use for displaying the item graphics in the inventory when it is a Set quality item (uses the file name as the input).

fields.name: useable
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the item can be used with the right-click mouse button command (this only works with specific belt items or quest items). If equals 0, then ignore this.

fields.name: stackable
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the item will use a quantity field and handle stacking functionality. This can depend on if the item type is throwable, is a type of ammunition, or is some other kind of miscellaneous item. If equals 0, then the item cannot be stacked.

fields.name: minstack
fields.description: Controls the minimum stack count or quantity that is allowed on the item. This field depends on the stackable field being enabled.

fields.name: maxstack
fields.description: Controls the maximum stack count or quantity that is allowed on the item. This field depends on the stackable field being enabled.

fields.name: spawnstack
fields.description: Controls the stack count or quantity that the item can spawn with. This field depends on the stackable field being enabled.

fields.name: Transmogrify
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the item will use the transmogrify function. If equals 0, then ignore this. This field depends on the useable field being enabled.

fields.name: TMogType
fields.description: Links to a code field to determine which item is chosen to transmogrify this item to.

fields.name: TMogMin
fields.description: Controls the minimum quantity that the transmogrify item will have. This depends on what item was chosen in the TMogType field, and that the transmogrify item has quantity.

fields.name: TMogMax
fields.description: Controls the maximum quantity that the transmogrify item will have. This depends on what item was chosen in the TMogType field, and that the transmogrify item has quantity.

fields.name: type
fields.description: This is the item's type, which controls how the item functions.

fields.name: type2
fields.description: Secondary item type. This is optional but can add more functionalities and possibilities with the item.

fields.name: dropsound
fields.description: Sound used when the item is dropped on the ground.

fields.name: dropsfxframe
fields.description: Defines which frame in the flippyfile animation to play the dropsound sound when the item is dropped on the ground.

fields.name: usesound
fields.description: Sound used when the item is moved in the inventory or used.

fields.name: unique
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the item can only spawn as a Unique quality type. If equals 0, then the item can spawn as other quality types.

fields.name: transparent
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the item will be drawn transparent on the player model (similar to ethereal models). If equals 0, then the item will appear solid on the player model.

fields.name: transtbl
fields.description: Controls what type of transparency to use, based on the transparent field being enabled. Corresponds to a ETRANSTYPE (enums).

fields.name: lightradius
fields.description: Controls the value of the light radius that this item can apply on the monster. This only affects monsters with this item equipped, not other types of units. This is ignored if the item's component on the monster is "lit", "med", or "hvy".

fields.name: belt
fields.description: Controls which belt type to use for belt items only. This field determines what index entry in the belts.txt file to use.

fields.name: quest
fields.description: Controls what quest class is tied to the item which can enable certain item functionalities for a specific quest. Any value greater than 0 will also mean the item is flagged as a quest item, which can affect how it is displayed in tooltips, how it is traded with other players, its item rarity, and how it cannot be sold to an NPC. If equals 0, then the item will not be flagged as a quest item.
table: Respec from Akara Complete, Act 5 Prologue

fields.name: questdiffcheck
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1 and the quest field is enabled, then the game will check the current difficulty setting and will tie that difficulty setting to the quest item. This means that the player can have more than 1 of the same quest item as long each they are obtained per difficulty mode (Normal / Nightmare / Hell). If equals 0 and the quest field is enabled, then the player can only have 1 count of the quest item in the inventory, regardless of difficulty.

fields.name: missiletype
fields.description: Points to an entry's index in missiles.txt, which determines what type of missile is used when using the throwing weapons

fields.name: durwarning
fields.description: Controls the threshold value for durability to display the low durability warning UI. This is only used if the item has durability.

fields.name: qntwarning
fields.description: Controls the threshold value for quantity to display the low quantity warning UI. This is only used if the item has stacks.

fields.name: mindam
fields.description: The minimum physical damage provided by the item.

fields.name: maxdam
fields.description: The maximum physical damage provided by the item.

fields.name: StrBonus
fields.description: The percentage multiplier that gets multiplied the player's current Strength attribute value to modify the bonus damage percent from the equipped item. If this equals 1, then default the value to 100.

fields.name: DexBonus
fields.description: The percentage multiplier that gets multiplied the player's current Dexterity attribute value to modify the bonus damage percent from the equipped item. If this equals 1, then default the value to 100.

fields.name: gemoffset
fields.description: Determines the starting index offset for reading the gems.txt file when determining what effects gems or runes will have the item based on the gemapplytype field. For example, if this value equals 9, then the game will start with index 9 ("Chipped Emerald") and ignore the previously defined gems in the gems.txt file, which can mean that those ignored gems will not apply modifiers when socketed into the item.

fields.name: bitfield1
fields.description: Controls different flags that can affect the item. Uses an integer value to check against different bit fields by using the "&" operator. For example, if the value equals 5 (binary = 101) then that returns true for both the 4 (binary = 100) and 1 (binary = 1) bit field values.

fields.name: NPCMin
fields.description: Minimum amount of this item type in Normal rarity that the NPC can sell at once.

fields.name: NPCMax
fields.description: Maximum amount of this item type in Normal rarity that the NPC can sell at once. This must be equal to or greater than the minimum amount.

fields.name: NPCMagicMin
fields.description: Minimum amount of this item type in Magical rarity that the NPC can sell at once

fields.name: NPCMagicMax
fields.description: Maximum amount of this item type in Magical rarity that the NPC can sell at once. This must be equal to or greater than the minimum amount.

fields.name: NPCMagicLvl
fields.description: Maximum magic level allowed for this item type in Magical rarity.

fields.name: Transform
fields.description: Controls the color palette change of the item for the character model graphics. Corresponds to a EITRANSFORMCLASS (enums).

fields.name: InvTrans
fields.description: Controls the color palette change of the item for the inventory graphics. Corresponds to a EITRANSFORMCLASS (enums).

fields.name: SkipName
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1 and the item is Unique rarity, then skip adding the item's base name in its title. If equals 0, then ignore this.

fields.name: NightmareUpgrade
fields.description: Links to another item's code field. Used to determine which item will replace this item when being generated in the NPC's store while the game is playing in Nightmare difficulty. If this field's code equals "xxx", then this item will not change in this difficulty.

fields.name: HellUpgrade
fields.description: Links to another item's code field. Used to determine which item will replace this item when being generated in the NPC's store while the game is playing in Hell difficulty. If this field's code equals "xxx", then this item will not change in this difficulty.

fields.name: Nameable
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then the item's name can be personalized by Anya for the Act 5 Betrayal of Harrogath quest reward. If equals 0, then the item cannot be used for the personalized name reward.

fields.name: PermStoreItem
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then this item will always appear on the NPC's store. If equals 0, then the item will randomly appear on the NPC's store when appropriate.

fields.name: EventItem
fields.description: Boolean Field. If equals 1, then this item will have its named colored with the FONTCOLOR (enums) "EventItemsColor".

fields.name: UICatOverride
fields.description: Allows this item to override what UI Category it should use (for loot filter and chronicle uniques page). If there's no override, this item will belong to the category that its type1 field uses. If Null, this item will be excluded from lootfilter / chronicle. If a valid UI Category, this item will belong to that UI category instead of the one its type would usually put it in.

fields.name: diablocloneweight
fields.description: The amount of weight added to the diablo clone progress when this item is sold. When offline, selling this item will instead immediately spawn diablo clone.
